jobs.title: Director, Data Enablement, Data Platforms
jobs.description:
Purpose. Performance. People. 

 Joining CPP Investments means joining one of the world’s most admired and respected institutional investors to drive a single mandate: to deliver strong, sustainable returns for generations of Canadians.   

 With a long-term horizon and global reach, we deploy capital at scale across public and private markets. Our size, stability, and disciplined investment philosophy allow us to pursue complex opportunities and build enduring partnerships worldwide.  

 For our people, this means meaningful work with tangible impact, real opportunity, and collaboration with exceptional colleagues who value partnership and performance. Here, you’ll contribute to outcomes that matter alongside team members committed to excellence and shared success.   

 Role Summary: 

As Director, Data Enablement, you will architect and evolve reusable enterprise platforms, tools, and services that help users and applications discover, understand, and securely consume trusted data products.

You will set technical direction for data portals, APIs, software development kits and consumption services; advance adoption across departments; and establish scalable operating practices, architecture standards and engineering excellence. Reporting details were not provided. 
 Accountabilities & Qualifications: 
 CPP Investments’ technology and data functions build secure, scalable enterprise capabilities that support investment, analytics, research and operational needs across the organization. The Data Enablement Team helps the organization derive value from enterprise data by delivering reusable platforms, tools and services, including the enterprise Data Portal, the FinSights BI Portal, low-latency consumption services, product governance capabilities and operational dashboards. 
 Accountabilities

 Develop deep relationships across the client’s marketing organization and broader agency-partner ecosystem.

 Lead strategic conversations, workshops, and presentations that create alignment and help clients make confident decisions.

 Partner with account leadership to protect, strengthen, and grow the business.

 Collaborate across creative, account, production, earned media, influencer, digital, social, technology, experience, and data and intelligence teams.

 Connect different disciplines and perspectives around a shared strategic vision.

 Navigate multiple projects, priorities, and stakeholders while maintaining a high bar for the work.

 Confidence building trusted relationships with senior clients and navigating complex stakeholder environments.

 A collaborative and generous leadership style, balanced by a commitment to rigor and high standards.

 Intellectual curiosity, cultural fluency, and a desire to continually find better ways to solve problems.

 The ability to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of the people, purpose, or quality of the work.

 8+ years in brand/communications strategy at a health agency or consultancy, with substantial experience in healthcare (e.g., retail health, pharmacy, payer and benefits, care delivery, or consumer health); adjacent wellness experience is a plus, partnering cross-functionally with creative, analytics, and client leadership

 Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

 This role is ideal for a forward-thinking finance leader who combines deep financial expertise with strong business acumen, operational excellence, and a passion for transforming finance through data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.

jobs.title: Head of Asset Lifecycle Planning
jobs.description:
Who we are: 

 Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities. 

  

 Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes. 

  

 Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our  blog  and follow us @InsideGeotab on  Instagram.  

 Who you are: 

 We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Head of Asset Lifecycle Planning who will own the solution domain that turns Geotab's telematics and cost data into prescriptive fleet capital decisions — enabling customers to operate the right-sized, right-aged, and right-deployed set of assets at the lowest total cost of ownership. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you! 

 What you'll do: 

 As a Head of Asset Lifecycle Planning, your key area of responsibility will be owning the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Asset Lifecycle Planning domain — spanning replacement and retirement planning, right-sizing, reallocation, utilization-driven capital recommendations, total cost of ownership analytics, and EV adoption strategy. You will be responsible for translating board-level strategic direction into product execution and ensuring confident, defensible capital decisions are made inside the product. You will need to work closely with cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, and product engineers, as well as partner closely with the Maintenance domain, platform teams, segment leads, and executive leadership. 

 To be successful in this role you will be a customer-obsessed, strategic leader with strong commercial instinct and the ability to connect customer pain to market opportunity and business value. In addition, the successful candidate will have deep cross-functional leadership experience across product management, design, and engineering disciplines, with the ability to operate at the intersection of business strategy, customer experience, and technical execution — owning outcomes while building and developing high-performing teams. 

 How you'll make an impact: 

 Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Asset Lifecycle Planning domain, ensuring confident, data-driven capital decisions (keep, replace, remove, reallocate, or buy) are made inside the product in minutes rather than weeks. 

 Lead the identification and resolution of product gaps, competitive risks, and market opportunities, maintaining a customer-demand-driven roadmap prioritized by impact to fleet outcomes and business KPAs. 

 Build, develop, and lead a cross-functional team of product managers, designers, and product engineers; provide coaching, mentorship, and career development to grow next-generation talent and emerging leaders. 

 Own the Asset Lifecycle Planning domain investment portfolio; make principled build/buy/partner decisions and trade-offs between new capability development, growth, customer satisfaction, and quality. 

 Partner with Heads of Platform Domain, Segment Domain, and peer Solution Domain leads to coordinate cross-cutting dependencies and ensure Asset Lifecycle Planning capabilities are packaged and positioned effectively for key customer segments. 

 Track and report on business outcomes, customer KPA attainment, and domain delivery health — including adoption, revenue, churn, and NPS — surfacing risks and recommendations to board leadership. 

 Establish feedback loops with customers, sales, and support teams to continuously capture product gaps and translate them into actionable improvements that drive fleet capital efficiency. 

 What you'll bring to the role: 

 5+ years in product management, product engineering, or related customer-facing product roles, with 5+ years of senior product and people leadership with cross-functional scope and direct accountability for customer-facing business outcomes. 

 Strong product leadership capability with demonstrated ability to define and execute customer-facing product strategy tied to measurable business outcomes, with P&L literacy and revenue attribution. 

 Deep customer empathy and commercial instinct — proven ability to connect customer pain to market opportunity, product investment, and business value. 

 Cross-functional leadership experience across product management, product design, and product engineering disciplines, with the ability to operate at the intersection of business strategy, customer experience, and technical execution. 

 Proficient in defining and tracking product KPIs, customer adoption metrics, and outcome-linked business indicators; familiarity with modern product discovery and validation practices. 

 Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; able to build effective partnerships with platform teams, segment leads, and executive leadership in evolving, ambiguous organizational structures. 

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent combination of education and work experience); relevant product management certifications (e.g., PSPO, CPO) considered an asset. 

 If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. 

  

 Please note: Geotab does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Geotab employees. 

  

 This posting is for an existing vacancy. 

  

 Why job seekers choose Geotab: 

 Flex working arrangements 
 Home office reimbursement program 
 Baby bonus & parental leave top up program 
 Online learning and networking opportunities 
 Electric vehicle purchase incentive program 
 Competitive medical and dental benefits 
 Retirement savings program 

 *The above are offered to full-time permanent employees only 

 How we work: 

 At Geotab, we have adopted a flexible hybrid working model in that we have systems, functions, programs and policies in place to support both in-person and virtual work. However, you are welcomed and encouraged to come into our beautiful, safe, clean offices as often as you like. When working from home, you are required to have a reliable internet connection with at least 50mb DL/10mb UL. Virtual work is supported with cloud-based applications, collaboration tools and asynchronous working. The health and safety of employees are a top priority. We encourage work-life balance and keep the Geotab culture going strong with online social events, chat rooms and gatherings. Join us and help reshape the future of technology! 

  

 We believe that ensuring diversity is fundamental to our future growth and progress and is an integral part of our business. We believe that success happens where new ideas can flourish – in an environment that is rich in diversity and a place where people from various backgrounds can work together. Geotab encourages applications from all qualified individuals. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities during the recruitment and assessment processes and when people are hired. We will ensure the accessibility needs of employees with disabilities are taken into account as part of performance management, career development, training and redeployment processes. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information about our diversity and inclusion as well as accommodation policies and practices, please contact us at careers@geotab.com. By submitting a job application to Geotab Inc. or its affiliates and subsidiaries (collectively, “Geotab”), you acknowledge Geotab’s collection, use and disclosure of your personal data in accordance with our Privacy Policy. Click here to read our Privacy Notice.  

 The annual base salary for this position is the expected annual salary for this role, and may be subject to change. Geotab offers various perks and benefits and other compensation components that an individual may be eligible for. The actual base salary for this position depends on a variety of factors such as but not limited to skills, qualifications, education and overall experience, including the location the applicant lives while performing the job. This also includes equity with other team members and alignment with local market data. All offers of employment are contingent upon proof of eligibility to work and the individual's ability to pass a background check.

 Hiring Range
 $163,800 — $227,500 CAD

jobs.title: Director, Data & AI (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Hi, Future Homie! 
 At Homebase, you’ll join a team that’s bold, fast-moving, and obsessed with helping small businesses thrive. We build with empathy, act with urgency, and take big swings that drive real-world impact. Here, every Homie shows up to raise the bar, support one another, and celebrate wins as a team.
 We’re not just building an app—we’re building unstoppable teams. So what do you say, are you in?

  📍Your Impact Starts Here 
 We’re looking for a Director, Data & AI to lead our Data Engineering, Data & ML Platform, Data Science, and Applied AI teams. You'll own the strategy, execution, and people leadership for a 20+ person org that powers everything from our data platform and analytics infrastructure to production ML models and AI-powered product experiences.
 This is a high-impact leadership role at the intersection of data and AI. You'll set the technical vision for how Homebase uses data as a product—trustworthy, consistent, and accessible—while driving applied AI initiatives that directly shape customer outcomes. You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and GTM leadership to ensure data and AI capabilities accelerate Homebase's growth strategy.
 These are the key ways you’ll contribute and create impact in this role: 
 Own the Data & AI strategy. Define and execute the technical roadmap across data engineering, data platform, data science, and applied AI. Align priorities to Homebase's product and business goals.

 Lead and grow a 20+ person org. Manage managers and senior ICs across four sub-teams. Recruit, develop, and retain top talent. Build a culture of velocity, ownership, and craft excellence.

 Drive data platform and infrastructure. Own the reliability, scalability, and governance of Homebase's data stack (Databricks, Unity Catalog, Airflow, dbt). Ensure data is a trusted, self-serve asset across the company.

 Accelerate applied AI and ML in product. Partner with Product and Engineering to ship AI-powered features—from LLM-based assistants to recommendation systems and intelligent automation. Own the MLOps lifecycle from experimentation to production.

 Drive data science rigor. Build experimentation frameworks, guardrail metrics, and evaluation pipelines that drive confident product decisions. Ensure models are reliable, fair, and cost-effective.

 Champion AI fluency org-wide. Coach your leaders to enable their teams with AI tools and workflows. Drive adoption of AI-assisted development practices (agentic coding, AI-augmented analytics). Measure and share impact.

 Set governance and standards. Define org-wide standards for data quality, model monitoring, data contracts, and responsible AI use. Be the authority on data architecture and AI governance.

 Partner cross-functionally. Work with Product, Growth, GTM, Finance, and CX to understand their data and AI needs. Enable a hub-and-spoke model where your team empowers the entire org to work with data effectively.

 🚀 The Foundation for Success - These are the experiences and strengths that will set you up for success in this role:
 10+ years in data and/or AI/ML, with at least 5 years leading teams of 8+ across data engineering, data science, or applied AI.

 Director-level leadership experience. You've managed managers, built orgs, and driven technical strategy at a company with real scale.

 Deep technical fluency across the modern data stack (warehousing, orchestration, transformation, BI) and applied ML/AI (production ML systems, LLMs, experimentation platforms).

 Strong product instincts. You connect data and AI work to customer outcomes and business metrics, not just technical milestones.

 AI-first mindset. You actively use AI to improve your own workflows and have led teams that ship AI-powered products. You stay current on frontier developments (LLMs, agentic systems, multimodal AI).

 Excellent communication. You translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and build trust across the org.

 Experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or similar. Familiarity with Unity Catalog, Airflow, dbt, and ML platforms (MLflow, Baseten, or equivalent) is a strong plus.

 Hybrid commitment. You're based in or willing to relocate to the Toronto area and are energized by in-person collaboration Tues/Weds at our Toronto hub.

 Bonus points if you bring: 
 Experience building data and AI orgs at a SaaS or marketplace company serving SMBs.

 Background in establishing data-as-a-product disciplines (data contracts, semantic layers, data mesh concepts).

 Experience with experimentation platforms and causal inference at scale.

 🤖 AI Fluency - We're an AI-first company. That's not a buzzword here—it's how we build. At the Director level, you are expected to:
 Push the boundaries of what's possible with AI across the organization, from production ML systems to agentic workflows, and lead a high-impact team that does the same.

 Enable teams and coach AI strategy. Ensure your managers and ICs are actively using AI to improve their workflows, and measure the impact.

 Drive adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices across Data & AI and the broader engineering org.

 Champion responsible AI use—set guardrails, evaluation standards, and governance frameworks.

 Stay current on frontier AI developments and translate them into Homebase's product and technical strategy.

 🤝  The Homie Way - These principles guide everything we do—from how we work and make decisions to how we show up for each other.
 💡 Be Customer Obsessed – Solve problems with empathy and creativity.

 ⚡ Move Fast, Learn Fast – Experiment, take action, and grow every day.

 🎯 Own Your Impact – Think big, focus on what matters, and make decisions you stand behind.

 🏆 Master Your Craft – Excellence fuels impact—show up, step up, and make your mark.

 🏅 Win Together – Put goals over roles, lead with trust, and connect to our mission and each other.

 What We Offer 
 💰 Ownership & Savings: Stock options + TFSA/RRSP with 4% company match

 🏥 Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents

 ⏰ Paid Time Off: Flexible PTO + company holidays + designated focus periods

 🤖 AI access, for real: We invest in builders and believe that curiosity shouldn't have a paywall. That means you'll have access to paid AI tools with minimal restrictions, so you can build, experiment, and level up your craft.

 👶 Family Support: Maternity/Parental Leave EI top-up support offered (after 6 months of service)

 🌟 Work Your Way: Work From Anywhere Month + meeting-free weeks yearly

 🛡️ Protection Plans: Life insurance + short/long-term disability coverage

 🍽️ Workspace Perks: Meals provided, team offsites, and Customer Days 

 💼 Our Hybrid Rhythm: We believe collaboration drives impact. That’s why Tuesdays and Wednesdays are our required in-office days —a time to move faster as a team, build deeper connections, make better decisions, and build together.

 What to Expect During the Interview Process 
 Meet the Talent Acquisition team. Mavel W. 

 Meet the Hiring Manager, Andrea C. 

 Meet with Engineering Leadership

 Participate in a Technical Deep Dive 

 Meet Cross-functional Partners

 Meet with the Chief Development Officer, Ankit B. 

 Background Check + Offer Stage

 Welcome to the team, Homie 🎉

 💜 Belonging at Homebase - We're committed to fostering a welcoming space where every Homie can be their full self. Experience comes in many forms—so if you're excited about this role, even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply! 
 Homebase will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. 

 👋 Hey, We’re Homebase 
 Homebase is the everything app for hourly teams—built to simplify the day-to-day and superpower local businesses. With tools for scheduling, time clocks, payroll, communication, HR, and more, we help teams stay connected and in control. Today, over 150,000 small (but mighty) businesses rely on us to make work radically easier. Together, we’ve tracked over a billion hours for 2M+ workers—and we’re just getting started.
 At Homebase, we celebrate diversity and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all candidates and do not discriminate based on any legally protected status. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know—we’re committed to ensuring fair and equitable access for all.

jobs.description:
Why you’ll love working here: 
 high-performance, people-focused culture

 our commitment that equity, diversity, and inclusion are fundamental to our work environment and business success, which helps employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves

 learning and development initiatives, including workshops, Speaker Series events and access to LinkedIn Learning, that support employees’ career growth

 membership in HOOPP’s world class defined benefit pension plan, which can serve as an important part of your retirement security

 competitive, 100% company-paid extended health and dental benefits for permanent employees, including coverage supporting our team's diversity and mental health (e.g., gender affirmation, fertility and drug treatment, psychological support benefits of $2,500 per year, parental leave top-up, and a health spending account).

 optional post-retirement health and dental benefits subsidized at 50%

 yoga classes, meditation workshops, nutritional consultations, and wellness seminars

 the opportunity to make a difference and help take care of those who care for us, by providing a financially secure retirement for Ontario healthcare workers

 Job Summary: 

 Reporting to the Vice President, Enterprise Communications, the Director, Enterprise Communications owns the communications strategy supporting HOOPP's investment activities and the external profile of the Office of the CEO. The role carries enterprise level accountability for how the Plan, the Fund and HOOPP's investment approach are understood by external audiences.

 The Director in partnership with the Vice President, Enterprise Communication sets the direction for investment communications, partnering with Investment Management and other business stakeholders on the narrative around portfolio construction, Fund performance, and market conditions. The Director is also accountable for the CEO's speeches, presentations, thought leadership, and key messaging.

 The role leads through influence, directing cross functional teams and external partners on major initiatives and coaching communications professionals across the organization. It calls for an exceptional writer and strategic thinker who absorbs complex investment subject matter quickly, advises with confidence, and delivers at pace with sound judgement and discretion. Investment and financial knowledge is a requirement of this role to support credibility in the room with investment professionals.

 What you will do: 

 Investment communications
 Own HOOPP's investment communications strategy, including the narrative, messaging architecture and external positioning for the Fund.
 Act as senior communications partner to Investment Management, working with the Chief Investment Officer, asset class leaders and subject matter experts on complex investment topics.
 Translate portfolio, market and economic subject matter, including the Total Portfolio Approach, Liability-Aware Investing and Sustainable Investing, into clear communications for external audiences.
 Lead communications for Fund performance milestones, annual and interim results, program launches, new strategies and significant transactions.
 Direct the key messages, statements, question-and-answer documents, and remarks that prepare investment spokespeople for external and industry engagements.
 Build relationships with external stakeholders and investment community contacts to identify storytelling opportunities.

 CEO and executive communications
 Serve as lead communications advisor to the CEO, accountable for speeches, presentations, speaking notes, and key messaging.
 Develop and steward the CEO's external communications platform and thought leadership agenda, aligned to HOOPP's business priorities and reputation objectives.
 Prepare the CEO and Executive Team for high profile external engagements, including conferences, industry events, panels, and stakeholder meetings.
 Counsel the Executive Team and as required, the Board of Trustees on positioning, messaging, and reputational considerations.
 Lead communications for major organizational announcements, executive events, and enterprise-wide engagements.
 Develop executive presentations, Board materials and briefing packages that meet the standards expected at the most senior levels.

 Enterprise leadership and delivery
 Set the cross-channel approach for the communications programs in scope, informed by organizational priorities and audience insight.
 Direct cross functional project teams, agencies, writers, and external partners on major initiatives, setting direction and holding delivery to standard.
 Coach and mentor communications professionals across the team, raising the collective standard of writing, editing, and counsel.
 Set and uphold quality, review, and approval standards for communications products, including accuracy, brand alignment, and accessibility.
 Define how success is measured for the programs in scope and use those measures to sharpen strategy and demonstrate impact.
 Represent Enterprise Communications on enterprise projects and governance forums, and improve communications processes, tools and standards.
 Manage budgets, agency relationships, and external vendors for assigned programs.

 What you bring: 

 Education and experience
 Post-secondary degree or diploma in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations, Business, Finance, Economics, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
 8 to 10 years of progressive communications experience, including demonstrated ownership of a communications strategy or program at an enterprise level.
 Demonstrated investment and financial knowledge is required, gained through direct experience in investment communications, capital markets, asset management, banking, pension plans or another institutional investment environment.
 Experience as a communications advisor to C-suite executives, including speechwriting and external platform development for a CEO or equivalent.
 Experience developing executive presentations, Board materials, conference presentations, and strategic communications for senior leaders.
 Experience operating effectively within a complex, highly regulated, or stakeholder-rich environment.
 Experience leading through influence, including directing cross functional teams, agencies and external partners without direct reporting authority.

 Skills and capabilities
 Exceptional written and oral communication, editing and storytelling skills, adapted to diverse audiences and channels, particularly external ones.
 Solid working knowledge of investment and financial concepts, including asset classes, portfolio construction, capital markets, and risk and return, with the ability to read and interpret financial statements and performance reporting.
 Strong business acumen and the ability to understand complex financial and investment concepts

jobs.title: Associate Director, Enterprise Communications
jobs.description:
Why you’ll love working here: 
 high-performance, people-focused culture

 our commitment that equity, diversity, and inclusion are fundamental to our work environment and business success, which helps employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves

 learning and development initiatives, including workshops, Speaker Series events and access to LinkedIn Learning, that support employees’ career growth

 membership in HOOPP’s world class defined benefit pension plan, which can serve as an important part of your retirement security

 competitive, 100% company-paid extended health and dental benefits for permanent employees, including coverage supporting our team's diversity and mental health (e.g., gender affirmation, fertility and drug treatment, psychological support benefits of $2,500 per year, parental leave top-up, and a health spending account).

 optional post-retirement health and dental benefits subsidized at 50%

 yoga classes, meditation workshops, nutritional consultations, and wellness seminars

 the opportunity to make a difference and help take care of those who care for us, by providing a financially secure retirement for Ontario healthcare workers

 Job Summary 

 Reporting to the Vice President, Enterprise Communications, the Associate Director, Enterprise Communications plays a key role in developing and delivering communication strategies and materials that support HOOPP's business priorities, investment activities, executive leadership and organizational reputation, with a strong emphasis on external audiences. 
 The successful candidate will work across a broad range of strategic initiatives, partnering with senior leaders and subject matter experts to develop clear, compelling communications for both internal and external audiences, with particular focus on external stakeholders, industry partners, investment community contacts, and other groups relevant to HOOPP's investment and executive profile. This includes executive presentations, external speaking remarks, thought leadership, briefing materials, stakeholder communications, award submissions, and other high-impact content that communicates complex business and investment topics. 
 The role requires a strong writer, strategic thinker and trusted advisor who can quickly grasp complex subject matter, provide sound communications counsel, and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will be highly collaborative, comfortable working with senior leaders and C-suite executives, and able to balance multiple priorities while exercising sound judgment and discretion. 

 What you will do: 
 Develop and execute strategic communications that support HOOPP's business priorities, investment activities, and broader organizational objectives, with a focus on external positioning. 

 Lead and support investment communications strategy.

 Partner closely with Investment Management, Strategy and other subject matter experts to develop accurate, compelling messaging on complex investment topics.

 Translate complex business, investment and market topics into clear, compelling communications for a variety of internal and external audiences. 

 Develop presentations, speeches, speaking notes, briefing materials, thought leadership content, award submissions and stakeholder communications. 

 Serve as the lead communications partner to the CEO on speeches, presentations and key messaging. 

 Provide strategic communications counsel and messaging support to senior leaders and executives, with particular emphasis on preparing them for external speaking opportunities, including conferences, industry events, panels, and other high-profile external engagements, to maximize the impact and alignment of key messaging. 

 Lead the development of key messages, statements, Q&As and speaking remarks to ensure HOOPP spokespeople are well-prepared for external stakeholder and industry events. 

 Provide high-level briefings on HOOPP investment initiatives, such as Annual Reports, Fund performance, program launches, and strategies, for external audiences. 

 Support executive communications initiatives and major organizational announcements, events and engagements. 

 Build strong relationships across the organization, and with relevant external stakeholders to identify storytelling opportunities and communications needs. 

 Develop high-quality content across a range of formats, including presentations, reports, executive materials, articles, digital content and other communications materials. 

 Recommend and help implement cross-channel approaches to communications based on organizational priorities, emerging opportunities and audience insights. 

 Ensure communications products consistently meet the highest standards of quality control and effectiveness. 

 Contribute to the continuous improvement of communications processes, tools and standards across the organization. 

 What you bring: 
 Post-secondary degree or diploma in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations, Business, Finance, Economics, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

 8-10 years of progressive communications experience, with strong exposure to investment communications, capital markets, asset management, banking, pension plans or other financial services environments.

 Exceptional written and oral communication, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to adapt messages effectively for diverse audiences, stakeholders and channels, particularly external audiences. 

 Demonstrated experience developing executive presentations, board materials, conference presentations and strategic communications for senior leaders. 

 Experience advising senior leaders and C-suite executives on external speaking opportunities and managing competing priorities in a dynamic environment. 

 Strong business acumen and the ability to understand and communicate complex financial and investment concepts. 

 Experience operating effectively within a complex, highly regulated or stakeholder-rich environment. 

 Skilled writer and editor, with significant experience writing, proofing and editing material, and presenting proposals and plans to senior leaders and Board members. 

 Deep understanding of the value of corporate communications and the role of multichannel storytelling in reaching external audiences. 

 Strong critical thinking and analytical skills to assess communications needs relevant to the CEO, Executive Team and Board. 

 Excellent judgment, discretion, attention to detail and project management skills. 

 Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels, internally and externally. 

 High professionalism and sound stakeholder judgment, with the ability to build trust, influence outcomes and respectfully challenge perspectives when appropriate.

 Highly motivated self-starter with the ability to work independently and deliver high-quality work with minimal direction. 

 Demonstrated proficiency in the use of artificial intelligence tools to enhance the effectiveness, efficiency and impact of both day-to-day and strategic communications, including the ability to leverage AI to develop content, generate insights, analyze stakeholder sentiment, optimize communications channels, and support enterprise-wide communication strategies. 

 A CFA, CIM, CAIA, MBA or accounting designation, held or in progress, would be considered an asset.

jobs.title: Chief Scientist - Physical AI
jobs.description:
Huawei Canada has an immediate permanent opening for a Chief Scientist. 

 About the team: 
 Founded in 2012, the Noah’s Ark lab has evolved into a prominent research organization with notable achievements in academia and industry. The lab’s mission focuses on advancing artificial intelligence and related fields to benefit the company and society. Driven by impactful, long-term projects, the aim is to enhance state-of-the-art research while integrating innovations into the company's products and services, including LLMs, RL, NLP, computer vision, AI theory, and Autonomous driving.   

 About the job: 
 Work at the forefront of Embodied AI and Spatial AI, collaborating with researchers and engineers to solve real-world challenges and bridge cutting-edge research with scalable deployment. 

 Develop state-of-the-art approaches in Physical AI, including robotic foundation models, world models, multimodal representation learning, reasoning and planning, as well as imitation and reinforcement learning with integrated low-level control. 

 Translate advanced problem formulations and model designs into efficient, production-grade systems, enabling rapid iteration through large-scale experimentation. 

 Design and execute experiments across both simulation and real-world robotic platforms, covering data collection, evaluation, and performance analysis. 

 Drive closed-loop learning by integrating data, models, and real-world feedback to continuously improve system robustness and adaptability. 

 Collaborate cross-functionally across research, infrastructure, and robotics systems to ensure end-to-end system coherence and scalability. 

 Contribute to and lead high-impact research outputs, including patents and publications in top-tier venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, and ICRA.

jobs.title: Technical VP - AI Data Platform
jobs.description:
Huawei Canada has an immediate permanent opening for a Technical VP. 

 About the team: 
 The Emerging Storage Lab is a research group based at Huawei Canada's Toronto Research Centre that is focused on next-generation data and storage technologies and innovations. Our team comprises graduate computer engineers and computer scientists with diverse industry experience, ranging from 0 to over 20 years. This lab investigates various data storage-related topics, including data management, data catalog, data fabric, file systems, storage networks, and AI storage, aiming to advance the field and drive data storage technological progress in the new AI era. 

 About the job: 
 Define the technology roadmap for next-generation data storage and AI retrieval systems, aligning with global R&D and business objectives. Set the global research agenda for AI Data Platforms, with a specific focus on vector-native data lakes, intelligent caching layers, and high-performance retrieval infrastructures that power Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). 

 Lead the lab’s transition to Data-Centric AI, pioneering research in Agent memory system, Knowledge Base, and RAG-optimized data intelligence systems. Drive innovation in dynamic data indexing, hybrid search (semantic + keyword), chunking/parsing strategies, and real-time context freshness—ensuring our storage architectures evolve to handle the unique throughput, latency and accuracy demands at petabyte scale. 

 Serve as both Architect and Evangelist, shaping the technical roadmap while maintaining hands-on involvement in critical projects. Lead architecture reviews and performance optimizations for end-to-end AI Data Platform, from unstructured data ingestion and metadata enrichment to vector database sharding and reranking strategies. Prototype next-gen architectures that unify file storage, data lakes, and low-latency vector indexes into a cohesive, AI-ready data stack. 

 Lead a world-class research lab, mentoring top-tier engineers and researchers in the specialized fields of Information Retrieval (IR), AI Model, Data Lake, and retrieval mechanisms. Foster a culture of innovation and collaboration focused on solving the challenges for enterprise AI. 

 Shape industry standards by publishing influential research on Agent Memory, Knowledge Base, RAG, patenting novel approaches, and representing the company in top-tier tech forums (e.g., VLDB, SIGIR, NeurIPS) to define the future of AI-native data management.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff to the Managing Director of AI
jobs.description:
Location: US or Canada
Type: US Applicants - Full-Time; Canadian Applicants - Independent Contractor 

 **A note before you read further** 

 The world is changing fast, and so is this role. We can't fully tell you what this job looks like in six months. That's true of every role at Human Agency right now. What we need from you, no matter what: accountability, curiosity, and a builder-first mindset. If that sounds exciting, keep reading. If it sounds intimidating but you're still interested, let's talk. If none of that sounds like you, that's okay. This probably isn't your spot.

 About Human Agency 

 We're scaling rapidly and have a growing pipeline of opportunities that demand exceptional talent across disciplines. Our mission is to bring on individuals, from creative producers to technical experts to entrepreneurial leaders, who can help us realize this next chapter of growth.

 We are a company of doers. Leaders roll up their sleeves, teams work flat, and everyone contributes to what ships. Titles don't insulate us from feedback or basics. We invite critique, learn quickly, and keep raising the bar. The best ideas win here, no matter where they come from, because clients trust us to deliver the strongest outcomes every time.

 Our clients' missions, products, and bottom lines are sacred. We immerse ourselves in their world, becoming stewards of their goals and partners in solving big problems. Every product, strategy, or asset we create must be both beautiful and functional; practical, usable, and designed for real-world impact.

 Humans are our most valuable resource, and we only grow by hiring people who push us forward. Across strategy, engineering, design, data, and operations, we seek out teammates who raise the bar and make us better. Always hire up, never down.

 We partner with organizations of all sizes to explore, design, and implement AI strategies that are secure, scalable, and human-centered. We believe AI should amplify human potential, not replace it and we build with that conviction in every engagement. From advisory and tooling to implementation and education, we meet clients where they are at and help them integrate AI in ways that align with their mission and values. Our goal is to empower teams to work smarter, move faster, and unlock new possibilities through thoughtful, responsible innovation.

 And through it all, we lead with purpose, love, and adventure. We do meaningful work with people we care about, and we make the ride an adventure worth taking. Because at Human Agency, who we are and how we work are one and the same.

 The Opportunity 

 We are seeking an exceptional Chief of Staff for our Managing Director of AI—someone who combines strategic vision in AI with hands-on execution and technological know-how. You'll be both a force-multiplier and a transformation architect: designing AI-enabled processes, building automated engines that run independently, leading organizational rollouts, and ensuring crisp execution across our AI solutions practice.

 This role goes beyond traditional Chief of Staff responsibilities. You'll design processes that leverage AI, build repeatable systems that scale, and lead entire client transformations from discovery to sustained adoption. You have the potential to grow into leading organizational-level AI implementations as the practice expands.

 Key Responsibilities 

 Strategic & Executive Leadership 

 Partner with the Managing Director of AI and the executive team to translate priorities into sequenced plans, resourcing, and measurable outcomes

 Lead Human Agency's AI transformation methodology: define offerings, build repeatable frameworks, and establish best practices for AI-enabled workflows

 Design end-to-end processes that embed AI tools (LLMs, automation platforms, knowledge assistants) into client workflows and internal operations

 Translate complex AI capabilities into clear business cases, use cases, and implementation roadmaps for executive audiences

 Produce high-quality executive materials (briefings, roadmaps, decision memos) that drive alignment and decisions

 Identify where AI creates leverage across client engagements and surface strategic opportunities to leadership

 AI Process Design & Automated Engines 

 Design and build AI-powered systems that operate independently with minimal ongoing intervention—automated engines that scale beyond individual engagements

 Create repeatable processes for AI implementation: discovery frameworks, solution architectures, evaluation routines, and governance models

 Design prompts, playbooks, and knowledge bases optimized for reliability, consistency, and reusability across multiple clients

 Implement lightweight automation using no/low-code tools (Zapier, Make, Airtable) integrated with AI capabilities

 Establish monitoring and feedback loops that enable self-correcting, continuously improving systems

 Document patterns and best practices that can be deployed at scale

 Client Service Delivery & Organizational Rollouts 

 Own end-to-end delivery on multiple client engagements involving AI-enabled solutions (e.g., knowledge assistants, workflow automations, content summarization, research copilots), from discovery through launch and sustained adoption

 Lead company-wide and client-wide AI adoption initiatives—managing stakeholder alignment, training, governance, and measurement across entire organizations

 Run comprehensive discovery to surface use cases, success metrics, risks, change-management needs, and technical requirements; translate findings into scopes, timelines, and clear acceptance criteria

 Coordinate solution build-outs with internal teammates and external partners: data/connectivity needs, tool selection, integration planning, prompt engineering, and rollout choreography

 Design change-management approaches that address skill gaps, cultural resistance, workflow disruption, and organizational readiness

 Partner with client leadership to sequence rollout phases, manage dependencies, and demonstrate ROI

 Quality, Governance & Evaluation 

 Set lightweight evaluation routines: accuracy metrics, latency benchmarks, cost tracking, quality assurance processes, and continuous improvement cycles

 Establish prompt/playbook management, basic safety/guardrail checks, and UAT plans

 Build governance frameworks that enable responsible, scalable AI adoption across organizations

 Implement monitoring systems that track performance, usage, and business impact

 Stakeholder Management & Enablement 

 Lead standing client check-ins, executive presentations, demo readiness, decision logs, and release notes, presenting succinct options and recommendations

 Create comprehensive enablement materials: user guides, FAQs, training programs, and governance playbooks that empower client teams to operate AI systems independently

 Build lasting client relationships through proactive communication, anticipation of needs, and consistent delivery quality

 Present to executive audiences with clarity and confidence, addressing concerns about accuracy, security, and adoption

 Operations & Project Management 

 Design and continuously improve the operating system for AI work: intake → triage → prioritization → delivery → QA → launch → measurement

 Manage staffing assignments and subcontractor contributions across concurrent workstreams; keep tools current (Asana/Notion, Google Workspace, Slack)

 Budget & scope control: track time against SOWs, flag changes early, manage vendors, and ensure on-budget delivery with clear documentation

 Establish shared dashboards for delivery health (timeline, risk, burn, dependency status) and run tight meeting cadences

 Communications & Reporting 

 Prepare agendas, briefings, and executive-ready presentations; synthesize complex information into actionable insights

 Provide clear, timely reporting to the Managing Director of AI and stakeholders on progress, risks, and decisions

 Contribute to Human Agency's AI thought leadership through documentation of best practices, case studies, and insights

 Who You Are 

 Experience & Skills 

 5-7+ years in operations, client services, product/program/project management, strategic support, consulting, or transformation roles with direct ownership of client-facing delivery

 Demonstrated success leading multi-stakeholder projects and organizational change initiatives end-to-end (scope, timelines, budgets, risk, and change management)

 Deep AI fluency: hands-on experience implementing LLM-enabled solutions, prompt engineering, workflow automation, and knowledge management systems; can shape prompts/playbooks, evaluate quality, and choose appropriate tools or vendors

 Strong understanding of AI capabilities and limitations, when to use AI, how to design for reliability, and how to manage risks responsibly

 Proven ability to design repeatable processes and systems that scale beyond individual projects

 Experience with no/low-code automation platforms (e.g., Zapier/n8n), knowledge bases, and modern AI tooling

 High proficiency with Google Workspace, Asana/Notion, Slack, and comfort with modern web and content tools; experience preparing polished executive documents and presentations

 Exceptional ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for non-technical audiences

 Bonus: Experience leading organizational-level technology rollouts, background in management consulting, familiarity with responsible AI considerations (privacy, data handling, consent, bias mitigation), or experience in AI/ML product development

 Mindset & Traits 

 Builder and operator: You design systems that work without constant oversight, not just execute tasks

 Strategic and tactical: Comfortable setting vision while rolling up sleeves for hands-on implementation

 AI pragmatist: Excited about possibilities but grounded in what actually delivers measurable value

 Mission-driven; systems thinker with bias for action

 Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence executive stakeholders and earn trust through delivery

 Calm under pressure with excellent judgment about when to escalate vs. solve independently

 Able to hold strategic context while driving tactical execution across multiple concurrent engagements

 Intellectually curious with strong learning agility, you stay current on AI capabilities and translate findings into practical applications

 Comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating structure where none exists

 Considerations 

 Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; an advanced degree in business, technology, or a related field is a plus

 Ethics: Commitment to ethical practices and responsible AI (transparency, human oversight, privacy, bias mitigation)

 Travel: Regular (20–40%) for client activities, organizational rollouts, and events

 Location: Remote-friendly with preference for candidates in major tech hubs

 Compensation 

 This role offers a competitive base salary with performance-based bonuses and potential equity participation. Final compensation will vary based on experience, performance, and location.

 Why Join Human Agency 

 Join a team of thinkers and builders creating meaningful impact across sectors—with autonomy to lead, the resources to succeed, and room to grow. This role offers the opportunity to shape how organizations integrate AI at scale, with clear pathways to increased leadership responsibility as our practice expands.

 Equal Opportunity Commitment 

 Human Agency is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diverse backgrounds and strive to build an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcomed and empowered.

 And through it all, we lead with purpose, love, and adventure. We do meaningful work with people we create about, and we make the ride an adventure worth taking. Because at Human Agency, who we are and how we work are one and the same.

 The Opportunity 

 Most AI consultants are good at one of two things: writing the strategy or doing the work. We need someone who refuses to separate the two. This role exists because our clients don't just need a roadmap - they need someone who will build the road, navigate the detours, and still show up to the steering committee with a clear-eyed point of view on where they're headed next.

 You'll lead AI transformation engagements end-to-end, from diagnosing what's broken and what's possible to rolling up your sleeves and building the thing alongside the client's team. That might mean designing an AI-enabled workflow on Monday, pressure-testing a product decision with a C-suite on Wednesday, and shipping a working prototype by Friday. The client doesn't see the seams. You own the outcome.

 This is the right role if you've spent years inside Big Four firms, strategy boutiques, or early-stage companies and found yourself frustrated by the gap between advice and execution. You know what good looks like, you've seen what happens when no one stays accountable for making it real, and you're done handing off decks to someone else's team. You want the whole thing - the strategy, the build, the proof.

 What You'll Own 

 Client Engagement Leadership — Run AI transformation projects from discovery through delivery, serving as the primary client relationship owner and the person ultimately accountable for outcomes.

 Strategy and Execution, Both — Develop transformation roadmaps grounded in a client's actual constraints, then stay in the work long enough to see them implemented, not handed off.

 0-to-1 Product Building — Identify high-value AI use cases, prototype solutions, and shepherd them from concept to something clients can actually use, often building hands-on alongside the client's internal team.

 Executive-Level Communication — Translate complex AI concepts, technical constraints, and strategic tradeoffs into crisp, confident communication for boards, C-suites, and frontline operators alike.

 Go-to-Market and Growth Support — Contribute to business development, help scope new engagements, and actively deepen relationships with existing clients as their needs evolve.

 AI Tool Deployment — Apply AI tools aggressively across your own workflow and your clients', not as a demo, but as a working standard for how fast and how well this work can get done.

 Internal Contribution — As a senior member of a flat, growing team, you'll help shape how Human Agency delivers, what we learn, and who we become.

 Who You Are 

 Experience & Skills 

 5–8+ years of experience in management consulting, venture-backed startups, product strategy, or a combination, with direct ownership over outcomes, not just deliverables.

 Demonstrated track record of taking AI from concept to working reality in an organizational context — not just advising on AI strategy, but building or deploying something that worked.

 Fluency with the AI tooling landscape — foundation models, workflow automation, prompt engineering, and the judgment to know when to build versus buy versus recommend against.

 Proven ability to lead client relationships at the senior level, including navigating organizational politics, managing ambiguity, and keeping complex engagements on track without a safety net.

 Strong written and verbal communication — you can write a crisp executive brief, run a working session with a skeptical VP, and explain a technical architecture decision to a non-technical founder, often in the same day.

 Experience in 0-to-1 product building — you've shipped something, taken something from nothing to real, and you can speak concretely about how you did it.

 Bonus: Background in venture studios, high-growth AI or tech companies, or operator roles at the intersection of strategy and product.

 Mindset & Traits 

 You're a builder first. Decks are useful; working things are better. You default toward making something real.

 You manage yourself completely. No one will check on your progress, remind you of a deadline, or coach you through a hard week. You are the accountability structure.

 You have no patience for the gap between strategy and execution and have spent your career closing it.

 You're curious about AI in a way that shows up in your actual work — you experiment, you break things, you have opinions formed by firsthand experience, not secondhand summaries.

 You can hold the big picture and the small detail simultaneously, and you know when to zoom in and when to zoom out without being told.

 You do what the work requires. Not what's in scope, not what's comfortable, not what's in your lane.

 Logistics 

 Location: Remote-first; US and Canada eligible. 

 Travel: Occasional travel required for client engagements, company offsites, and key strategic meetings.

 Application Note: Attach proof of something you've built with AI — a product, a workflow, a tool, a result. If you don't have something to show, this is not the right role.

 Equal Opportunity Commitment 

 Human Agency is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to building inclusive, high-performing teams where everyone can do their best work.

jobs.title: AVP, GTO Strategy & Transformation
jobs.description:
As AVP, GTO Strategy & Transformation, you will lead GTO's strategy, transformation agenda, and multi-year roadmap, while also overseeing the GTO global AI platform roadmap. Your focus will be on shaping where GTO is going and ensuring its transformation delivers measurable business value. You will lead multi-year strategy development, operating model transformation, AI enablement, value realization, workforce modernization, and enterprise-scale transformation initiatives. Working closely with Technology, Operations, Finance, People Partners, and business leaders, you will identify opportunities to redesign how work gets done, convert productivity gains into measurable business outcomes, and help build an AI-enabled growth engine that supports growth while maintaining expense discipline. This is an AI-native team — the team uses AI tools, agentic workflows, and LLM-connected platforms as its primary way of working, not as an occasional add-on. 

 Position Responsibilities: 
 GTO Strategy & Strategic Planning: Lead development of multi-year GTO strategy, transformation roadmaps, investment priorities, and strategic planning processes. Translate enterprise objectives into executable plans across Technology and Operations, ensuring strategic intent is reflected in investment and delivery decisions before resources are committed.
 AI-Native Operating Model Transformation: Design and evolve future-state operating models that combine AI, automation, workforce transformation, and technology productivity to sustainably improve capacity, customer outcomes, and efficiency across Technology and Operations — including delivery models, product operating models, workforce structures, and technology ways of working.
 Technology Productivity Realization: Partner with CIOs, COOs, and segment leaders to identify, quantify, and realize value from technology productivity improvements — including product operating models, engineering productivity, and delivery modernization — ensuring productivity gains translate into measurable operational and business outcomes rather than remaining theoretical.
 Operational Transformation & Value Realization: Lead enterprise operational transformation initiatives across customer service, operations, digital channels, workforce productivity, and support functions. Current focus areas may include contact centre transformation, containment optimization, service modernization, and AI-enabled efficiency programs — with the underlying methodology (diagnostic rigor, cross-source data reconciliation, quantified business cases) designed to generalize to future transformation priorities as GTO's agenda evolves.
 Workforce Transformation & Future Skills: Define workforce transition strategies, future-skill requirements, role redesign opportunities, and redeployment approaches required to support AI-enabled operating models. Partner with People Partners, L&D, and segment leaders to drive execution — setting direction, tracking progress, and identifying opportunities to accelerate adoption in partnership with segment leaders.
 Enterprise Value Realization: Own benefit targets and KPI commitments across the GTO transformation portfolio. Establish and govern enterprise value realization methodologies, validate assumptions, reconcile benefit calculations across data sources, create defensible performance baselines, and ensure reported outcomes remain transparent and defensible to senior leadership and ELT — explicitly separating transformation-driven impact from organic or external trends.
 Product & Portfolio Leadership Strengthened: Own and evolve the GTO AI product roadmap, defining priorities and sequencing releases across initiatives and reusable capabilities. Ensure product investments align with GTO strategic priorities and target-state operating model objectives, rather than being pursued independently of the broader transformation agenda.
 Executive & Board-Level Narrative Ownership: Own the preparation of ELT and Board/Technology Committee-ready materials — portfolio checkpoints, anticipated-Q&A briefs, and strategic narratives — translating complex, multi-segment operational and financial data into clear, decision-ready formats. Anticipate scrutiny across every segment and function represented, not just the primary owner's area, and ensure diplomatic, precise, and defensible framing throughout.
 GTO Global AI Platform Roadmap Ownership: Own and oversee the GTO global AI platform roadmap — set the AI direction and transformation agenda for GTO across 14 countries, translate enterprise AI vision into operational priorities, and ensure the platform roadmap is directly sequenced against GTO's broader multi-year strategy and transformation agenda rather than developed in isolation. Apply strategic rigour to problem framing and solution design, ensuring the right problems are prioritized before delivery resources are committed, and assess strategic AI hypotheses through structured pilots prior to scaling investment.
 Outcome Measurement: Establish clear success measures — adoption, operational impact, cycle-time improvements, reliability — and report progress to senior leadership.
 Delivery Execution: Lead end-to-end delivery planning and execution for approved transformation and AI initiatives, ensuring predictable release rhythms and timely removal of blockers.
 Competitive Intelligence: Maintain ongoing awareness of AI and transformation developments across financial services and the broader enterprise landscape. Translate external signals — competitor moves, emerging capabilities, regulatory shifts — into strategic implications for the GTO agenda.
 Production Readiness: Drive readiness reviews with Technology, Enterprise AI, and Risk partners to confirm controls, documentation, and deployment plans are in place prior to release.
 Cross-functional Escalation: Act as escalation point for delivery throughput issues, coordinating cross-functional resolution and trade-off decisions.
 Platform Reuse & Scaling: Lead the shift from project-by-project delivery to a reusable capability model — shared components, templates, evaluation patterns, and connectors.
 Governance Alignment: Ensure solutions align with Responsible AI and model risk expectations, including appropriate documentation and monitoring plans.
 Opportunity Identification & Prioritization: Identify, quantify, and prioritize AI and operational-transformation opportunities across GTO using structured analysis and operational input — including digital-capability heatmapping, deflection/containment sizing, and repeat-contact root-cause analysis. Build data-driven business cases with Finance and Operations leaders, using the same rigor applied to product investment decisions.
 Transformation Investment Prioritization: Evaluate strategic initiatives, validate business cases, recommend investment priorities, and support trade-off decisions across the GTO portfolio.
 Executive Decision Support & Strategic Communications: Serve as a primary architect of executive decision support across GTO — ELT materials, Board and Technology Committee narratives, investor-facing content, anticipated-Q&A preparation, and strategic storyline development. Treat this as a defining capability of the function, not a byproduct of other work: the quality of this synthesis directly shapes how senior leadership and the Board understand GTO's transformation progress.
 AI-First Operating Model: Lead by example in how the team works. jobs.title: Directeur(trice) principal(e), Finance - Planification et Analyse Financières d'entreprise / Senior Director, Finance - Corporate FP&A
jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

 What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

 Résumé du poste 
 Le Directeur principal, Finance – FP&A corporatif, est responsable de l’élaboration, de la communication et de la mise en œuvre de la planification et de l’analyse financières pour la consolidation de McKesson Canada. Il agit comme principal interlocuteur financier auprès de McKesson Corporate et des équipes de direction des différentes unités d’affaires pour les prévisions, le budget, le plan à long terme ainsi que pour tout projet ponctuel nécessitant une analyse financière. Il conseille la haute direction en tant que partenaire d’affaires dans la consolidation des budgets, des prévisions et des plans à long terme, tant au niveau stratégique que tactique.

 Responsabilités principales 
 • Agir comme partenaire d’affaires et conseiller financier clé auprès du VP, Finance, FP&A corporatif, ainsi que du CFO.
• Diriger et superviser toutes les activités liées à la planification et à l’analyse financières pour l’unité d’affaires de McKesson Canada, incluant notamment les rapports financiers, les budgets annuels, les prévisions mensuelles, les revues opérationnelles trimestrielles, les plans à long terme et les analyses financières ponctuelles.
• Conseiller la haute direction sur les implications financières des décisions d’affaires, identifier et gérer les risques et opportunités associés aux opérations et au plan à long terme (consolidation McKesson Canada).
• Fournir du soutien stratégique, de la planification de scénarios, ainsi que des analyses de risques et d’opportunités afin d’atteindre les objectifs financiers prévus et à long terme.
• Diriger le développement d’évaluations continues des objectifs financiers stratégiques à court et long terme et recommander des solutions aux parties prenantes, en tenant compte des facteurs internes et externes, de l’impact du marché, de la législation et de l’alignement avec les objectifs financiers corporatifs.
• Diriger les discussions et favoriser le consensus entre les équipes sur les sujets interdépendants entre les BU.
• Jouer un rôle clé dans l’avancement de la stratégie FP&A de McKesson Canada à travers les différents groupes.
• Soutenir l’équipe dans l’identification et la mise en œuvre de stratégies visant à maximiser la précision des prévisions au sein des différentes unités d’affaires.
• Appuyer l’équipe dans les livrables de fin de mois.
• S’assurer qu’à un niveau consolidé, les objectifs budgétaires sont atteints et que la croissance attendue pour les années futures est adéquate. Communiquer clairement au VP, Finance FP&A et M&A ainsi qu’aux CFO des BU les risques et opportunités pour l’année en cours et les années futures.
• Diriger des équipes interfonctionnelles pour suivre la performance des indicateurs clés par rapport au budget ou aux analyses financières prévues.
• Déterminer les normes et indicateurs permettant de mesurer la performance financière de McKesson Canada.
• Concevoir et communiquer des modèles flexibles (tests de résistance, gestion des dépenses, analyse coûts variables vs coûts fixes, etc.) afin d’assurer une communication efficace avec les parties prenantes et une intégration fluide dans les processus de clôture mensuelle, de prévision et de budgétisation annuelle.
• Identifier et communiquer les KPI/indicateurs clés à la haute direction, en mettant en lumière leur impact global sur l’entreprise avec des rapports clairs et concis.
• Assurer un environnement de contrôle interne hautement efficace et veiller au respect de tous les processus SOX dans le cadre du budget et du plan à long terme.

 Analyse et performance financière 
 • Diriger l’analyse des résultats financiers de l’entreprise en lien avec les profits, tendances, coûts, et conformité aux budgets, prévisions et plan à long terme.
• Surveiller les résultats financiers mensuels, trimestriels et annuels et recommander des solutions stratégiques essentielles à la croissance de l’entreprise.
• Développer et mettre en œuvre des KPI appropriés et ponctuels pour l’équipe de direction des BU, ainsi que des indicateurs permettant la gestion en temps réel des activités.
• Remettre en question les soumissions financières des BU pour les budgets, plans à long terme et prévisions continues afin d’assurer que les économies nécessaires sont prises en compte et que les coûts sont correctement reflétés.
• Guider la direction dans le développement des hypothèses mensuelles lors des prévisions et du rolling forecast; élaborer des plans de réussite pour les budgets et le plan à long terme qui seront examinés et approuvés par l’équipe de direction exécutive.
• Agir comme partenaire d’affaires du groupe des relations avec les investisseurs chez Corporate pour représenter les principaux moteurs et la performance du Canada par rapport à l’année précédente.
• Diriger et soutenir les initiatives d’amélioration des processus et les projets de mise en œuvre de systèmes liés à la planification financière (incluant les projets dirigés par le corporate).

 Responsabilités générales 
 • Agir comme la ressource principale de l’entreprise dans son domaine d’expertise, en fournissant leadership et orientation sur tous les enjeux connexes.
• Promouvoir les principes I2CARE et ILEAD de McKesson Canada et de McKesson, en démontrant l’exemple et en encourageant les autres à faire de même.
• Gérer efficacement l’équipe: soutenir, guider et diriger le personnel. Favoriser un haut niveau d’engagement, déléguer adéquatement et fournir orientation, soutien et attentes claires.
• Encourager une communication ouverte, constructive et en temps opportun. Effectuer l’évaluation des performances des employés et soutenir leur développement.
• Promouvoir la collaboration au sein de l’équipe et entre les différents groupes et départements.
• Maintenir une communication appropriée avec tous les niveaux de l’organisation.
• Veiller au respect des politiques de l’entreprise.

 Qualifications 
 • Baccalauréat en commerce avec spécialisation en finance ou comptabilité. Titre comptable professionnel (CPA) requis; solide expertise comptable.
• Minimum de 15 années d’expérience en comptabilité et gestion dans un rôle similaire, incluant au moins 10 années d’expérience en FP&A, idéalement dans une entreprise internationale.
• Expérience démontrée en interaction avec la haute direction et en développement de stratégies financières innovantes.
• Maîtrise approfondie de la planification et de l’analyse financières, des systèmes associés, ainsi que des principes économiques et analytiques liés aux affaires.
• Pensée stratégique, innovante et proactive, avec désir de travailler dans un environnement en évolution.
• Présence exécutive: capacité à interagir avec les dirigeants, influencer sans autorité et défendre ses positions.
• Habileté démontrée à gérer plusieurs livrables simultanément avec un fort sens de l’urgence.
• Excellente communication et fortes capacités d’influence.
• Esprit d’équipe, leadership et excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles.
• Esprit analytique et stratégique, sens de l’organisation, autonomie.
• Capacité à synthétiser des analyses complexes en recommandations claires pour la haute direction.
• Leader de talent capable de maintenir une culture d’excellence.
• Jugement exceptionnel, initiative, rapidité d’apprentissage.
• Bilinguisme (oral et écrit).
• Connaissance avancée des systèmes financiers (ERP, suite Microsoft Office, etc.); la connaissance de SAP, HFM et BPC constitue un atout.

jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

 What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

 Position Summary    

 The Senior Director of Audit, Compliance & Automation (M5) is a senior enterprise leader responsible for driving end-to-end audit readiness, compliance execution, and large-scale automation of control processes across infrastructure platforms and services.   

 This role provides strategic direction, governance, and operational leadership to ensure regulatory adherence, audit excellence, and continuous control optimization. It integrates   audit, GRC frameworks, and automation engineering   to transform compliance from a reactive process into a proactive, scalable, and technology-enabled capability.   

 Operating at the intersection of   compliance, infrastructure operations, and automation, the role partners with executive leadership, audit committees, and platform teams to ensure enterprise-wide control effectiveness, risk transparency, and measurable improvements in audit outcomes.   

 Key Responsibilities   

 1. Enterprise Audit & Compliance Leadership   

 Lead enterprise-wide audit readiness strategy across data center, infrastructure, and platform environments.   

 Own relationship with internal audit, external auditors, and regulatory bodies.   

 Oversee audit lifecycle (planning, walkthroughs, evidence collection, remediation tracking).   

 Ensure consistent execution of control frameworks (e.g., SOX ITGC, security, operational controls).   

 Drive closure of audit findings, ensuring sustainable remediation and root-cause elimination.   

 2. Automation of Controls & Audit Processes   

 Define and execute a strategy to   automate audit evidence collection, control monitoring, and certification workflows.   

 Partner with engineering and platform teams to embed   automated controls into infrastructure systems.   

 Lead adoption of tools (e.g., ServiceNow GRC, workflow platforms) to digitize compliance processes.   

 Drive continuous control monitoring (CCM) and real-time risk visibility.   

 Eliminate manual audit processes through intelligent automation and integration.   

 3. Governance, Risk & Controls Strategy   

 Design and implement enterprise GRC frameworks integrated with infrastructure transformation initiatives (DDC exit, cloud migration,   colo   consolidation).   

 Establish standardized control libraries, policies, and governance models across platforms.   

 Lead risk identification, assessment, and mitigation strategies for infrastructure services.   

 Provide executive dashboards and   reporting   on compliance posture, risk exposure, and audit health.   

 4. Operational Integration with Infrastructure Teams   

 Embed compliance and audit requirements into   run   and   build   operating models.   

 Ensure controls are integrated into   day-2 operations, provisioning workflows, and platform engineering standards.   

 Partner with infrastructure leaders to align audit compliance with transformation initiatives (cloud, EUC, data center exits).   

 Drive accountability for control ownership across engineering and operations teams.   

 5. Executive Advisory & Stakeholder Engagement   

 Serve as a trusted advisor to   EITP Infrastructure VP   and senior leadership on audit risk, compliance posture, and regulatory exposure.    

 Prepare executive briefings for audit committees and   SteerCos.   

 Represent Infrastructure in enterprise compliance and audit forums.   

 Translate audit and control requirements into business-aligned strategies.   

 6. Organizational Leadership & Talent Development: 

 Build a high-performing organization blending   audit expertise, compliance professionals, and automation engineers.   

 Develop talent pipelines and succession plans for critical governance and automation roles.   

 Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement.   

 Minimum Requirements: 
 Degree or equivalent experience. Typically requires 13+ years of professional experience and 6+ years of diversified leadership, planning, communication, organization, and people motivation skills (or equivalent experience).

 Critical Skills:

 8 + years of experience in   audit, compliance, risk management, or infrastructure governance.   

 8+ years of leadership experience managing enterprise-scale teams and programs.   

 Proven experience leading large-scale audit programs (SOX, ITGC, regulatory audits).   

 Experience driving automation in compliance or operational processes.   

 Background in enterprise infrastructure, cloud, or data center environments strongly preferred.   

 Technical & Functional Expertise: 

 IT General Controls (ITGC) / SOX compliance   

 Audit lifecycle, walkthroughs, evidence management   

 Risk management frameworks and control design   

 ServiceNow GRC or similar platforms   

 Workflow automation and reporting tools   

 Infrastructure environments (compute, network, storage, DC operations)   

 Strong understanding of integrating compliance into engineering and operational processes   

 Leadership Competencies: 

 Strategic thinking and enterprise influence   

 Executive communication and stakeholder management   

 Ability to drive transformation across siloed teams   

 Strong governance and decision-making discipline   

 Data-driven mindset with focus on measurable outcomes
