jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable.  What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas.  Directeur(trice) principal(e) de l’architecture de solutions/Senior Director, Solution Architecture

 À propos du poste

 McKesson recherche un(e) Directeur(trice) Principal(e), Architecture d’Entreprise et Expérience Numérique pour diriger la stratégie d’architecture couvrant l’architecture de solutions, l’architecture applicative, la modernisation des solutions héritées (legacy) et la gestion de l’expérience numérique. Ce leader définira la vision de solutions technologiques modernes, évolutives, sécurisées et centrées sur le client afin de soutenir les priorités de l’entreprise et d’améliorer les résultats opérationnels.
 Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez les pratiques d’architecture qui relient la stratégie d’affaires à l’exécution technologique. Vous collaborerez avec les dirigeants, les équipes produits, ingénierie, sécurité, opérations et les parties prenantes métier afin de moderniser les plateformes, simplifier les environnements hérités, orienter la stratégie d’expérience numérique et renforcer la gouvernance architecturale. Vous développerez également les talents, influencerez les décisions à l’échelle de l’entreprise et aiderez les équipes à livrer des solutions technologiques à fort impact dans un environnement complexe et réglementé.

 Ce que vous ferez
 Diriger la pratique d’architecture d’entreprise couvrant l’architecture de solutions, l’architecture applicative, la modernisation et la gestion de l’expérience numérique.
 Définir les normes d’architecture, les feuilles de route, les modèles de gouvernance et les cadres décisionnels permettant une livraison technologique sécurisée et évolutive.
 Collaborer avec les dirigeants et les responsables métier afin d’aligner la stratégie d’architecture sur les objectifs d’affaires, les besoins des clients et les priorités de l’entreprise.
 Diriger les stratégies de modernisation des applications et plateformes héritées, y compris la rationalisation applicative, la migration vers le cloud, l’intégration, l’automatisation et la réduction de la dette technique.
 Orienter l’architecture de l’expérience numérique afin d’améliorer l’utilisabilité, l’accessibilité, la performance, la fiabilité ainsi que les parcours clients et employés de bout en bout.
 Conseiller les équipes sur les modèles d’architecture modernes, notamment les API, les microservices, les plateformes cloud natives, l’intégration de données, la gestion des identités, la sécurité et l’observabilité.
 Superviser la planification du portefeuille d’architecture, la stratégie fournisseurs, les recommandations d’investissement et la création de valeur mesurable.
 Développer les responsables et les équipes d’architecture grâce au mentorat, à la gestion des talents, à l’évaluation de la performance et à un leadership inclusif.

 Exigences de base
 13 ans ou plus d’expérience professionnelle en technologie, dont au moins 6 ans dans des fonctions de leadership en architecture, ingénierie, livraison d’applications, plateformes numériques ou transformation technologique. 
 Diplôme universitaire en informatique, systèmes d’information, ingénierie ou domaine connexe, ou expérience équivalente.
 Expérience dans la direction d’architectures d’entreprise, de solutions ou applicatives dans des environnements technologiques de grande envergure.
 Expérience de la conception et de la modernisation d’architectures de solutions d’entreprise en s’appuyant sur des plateformes intégrant l’intelligence artificielle et des technologies émergentes afin de stimuler l’innovation, l’évolutivité et la création de valeur.
 Expérience dans l’élaboration de stratégies d’architecture, de feuilles de route, de normes, de modèles de gouvernance et de recommandations destinées aux dirigeants.
 Expérience dans la modernisation d’applications, de plateformes ou de capacités numériques héritées.
 Expérience en gestion de responsables, d’équipes d’architecture ou d’équipes technologiques multidisciplinaires.
 Expérience de collaboration avec des parties prenantes métier et technologiques de haut niveau pour influencer la stratégie et l’exécution.
 Expérience en planification budgétaire, gestion des fournisseurs, priorisation de portefeuille ou prise de décisions d’investissement technologique.

 Compétences et expériences privilégiées
 Expérience avec les plateformes cloud, les stratégies API, les microservices, l’architecture événementielle (event-driven), le DevSecOps ou l’ingénierie de plateformes.
 Expérience en gestion de l’expérience numérique, plateformes d’expérience client, portails, applications mobiles/web ou solutions omnicanales.
 Expérience dans les secteurs de la santé, de la distribution pharmaceutique, de la chaîne d’approvisionnement, du commerce de détail ou d’autres environnements d’entreprise réglementés.
 Expérience des cadres d’architecture d’entreprise, des comités de revue d’architecture, de la modélisation des capacités ou de la gestion de portefeuille applicatif.
 Expérience de direction de programmes de transformation à grande échelle impliquant plusieurs équipes, fonctions ou unités d’affaires.
 Excellentes compétences en communication avec les dirigeants et capacité à simplifier des décisions technologiques complexes pour des audiences métier.
 Capacité démontrée à améliorer la performance opérationnelle, réduire la dette technique et accélérer la mise sur le marché.
 Style de leadership axé sur la collaboration, la vision stratégique, la conduite du changement, l’orientation client et le développement des talents.

 Déplacements, présence au bureau et exigences physiques
 Le modèle de travail peut être à distance, hybride ou en présentiel selon les besoins de l’entreprise et de l’équipe.
 Des déplacements occasionnels peuvent être requis pour des réunions de leadership, des sessions de planification, des rencontres avec des fournisseurs ou des activités de collaboration d’équipe.
 Le poste requiert une utilisation régulière de l’ordinateur ainsi qu’une participation à des réunions virtuelles et en personne.

 About the Role 
 McKesson is seeking a Senior Director, Enterprise Architecture & Digital Experience to lead architecture strategy across solution architecture, application architecture, legacy solution modernization, and digital experience management. This leader will set the vision for modern, scalable, secure, and customer-centered technology solutions that support enterprise priorities and improve business outcomes.
 In this role, you will lead architecture practices that connect business strategy to technology execution. You will partner with senior leaders, product, engineering, security, operations, and business stakeholders to modernize platforms, simplify legacy environments, guide digital experience strategy, and strengthen architecture governance. You will also develop leaders, influence enterprise decisions, and help teams deliver high-impact technology solutions in a complex, regulated environment.

 What You’ll Do 
 Lead the enterprise architecture practice across solution architecture, application architecture, modernization, and digital experience management.
 Define architecture standards, roadmaps, governance models, and decision frameworks that enable scalable and secure technology delivery.
 Partner with executive and senior business leaders to align architecture strategy with business objectives, customer needs, and enterprise priorities.
 Lead legacy application and platform modernization strategies, including rationalization, cloud migration, integration, automation, and technical debt reduction.
 Guide digital experience architecture to improve usability, accessibility, performance, reliability, and end-to-end customer and employee journeys.
 Advise teams on modern architecture patterns, including APIs, microservices, cloud-native platforms, data integration, identity, security, and observability.
 Oversee architecture portfolio planning, vendor strategy, investment recommendations, and measurable value delivery.
 Build and develop architecture leaders and teams through coaching, talent planning, performance management, and inclusive leadership practices.

 Basic Requirements 
 13+ years of professional technology experience, including 6+ years of leadership experience in architecture, engineering, application delivery, digital platforms, or technology transformation. 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
 Experience leading enterprise, solution, or application architecture across large-scale technology environments.
 Lead the design and modernization of enterprise solution architectures, leveraging AI-enabled platforms and emerging technologies to drive innovation, scalability, and business value.
 Experience developing architecture strategy, roadmaps, standards, governance, and executive-level recommendations.
 Experience leading modernization of legacy applications, platforms, or digital capabilities.
 Experience managing leaders, architecture teams, or cross-functional technology teams.
 Experience partnering with senior business and technology stakeholders to influence strategy and delivery.
 Experience with budget planning, vendor management, portfolio prioritization, or technology investment decisions.

 Preferred Skills/Experience 
 Experience with cloud platforms, API strategy, microservices, event-driven architecture, DevSecOps, or platform engineering.
 Experience with digital experience management, customer experience platforms, portals, mobile/web applications, or omnichannel solutions.
 Experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical distribution, supply chain, retail, or other regulated enterprise environments.
 Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks, architecture review boards, capability modeling, or application portfolio management.
 Experience leading large-scale transformation programs across multiple teams, functions, or business units.
 Strong executive communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technology decisions for business audiences.
 Demonstrated ability to improve operational performance, reduce technical debt, and increase speed-to-market.
 Leadership approach aligned to collaboration, strategic insight, change leadership, customer focus, and talent development.

 Description of Travel or In-Office and Physical Requirements 
 Work model may be remote, hybrid, or office-based depending on business and team needs.
 Occasional travel may be required for leadership meetings, planning sessions, vendor engagements, or team collaboration.
 Role requires regular use of a computer and participation in virtual and in-person meetings.

 ENGLISH DESCRIPTION FOLLOWS 

 Modalités de travail: Il s’agit d’un poste hybride qui exige que les candidat(e)s travaillent sur place au moins 2 jours par semaine dans notre bureau de Montréal. Les autres jours peuvent être travaillés à distance, selon les besoins de l’équipe et de l’unité d’affaire.

 À propos du poste (sommaire): 

 Le ou la D irecteur(trice) principal(e), Opérations du marketing numérique est responsable de définir et de mettre en œuvre la stratégie organisationnelle liée aux plateformes numériques et aux technologies marketing. Cette personne dirige les produits numériques, les plateformes marketing, les processus opérationnels et des équipes multidisciplinaires afin d’offrir des expériences numériques performantes, évolutives et alignées sur les objectifs de croissance de l’entreprise et d’engagement de la clientèle. 

 Ce rôle combine le leadership stratégique, la gestion de produits numériques, l’expertise en technologies marketing (MarTech), l’excellence opérationnelle et la prise de décision fondée sur les données. La personne retenue collaborera étroitement avec les équipes Marketing, Technologies, Produits numériques et les leaders d’affaires afin d’optimiser les plateformes, d’améliorer l’efficacité opérationnelle et de faire progresser les initiatives de transformation numérique. 

 Ce que vous ferez (responsabilités): 

 Stratégie numérique et leadership: 
 Élaborer et mettre en œuvre une stratégie pluriannuelle liée aux plateformes numériques et aux technologies marketing, en cohérence avec les objectifs organisationnels et commerciaux. 

 Établir les priorités stratégiques, les normes opérationnelles, les indicateurs de performance et les cadres de gouvernance pour les opérations de marketing numérique. 

 Diriger et développer des équipes hautement performantes en favorisant la collaboration, l’innovation et l’amélioration continue. 

 Gestion des produits et des plateformes numériques: 
 Assurer la responsabilité de la feuille de route et de la gestion du cycle de vie des produits numériques, notamment les sites Web, les applications mobiles et les autres plateformes soutenant les activités marketing. 

 Collaborer avec les équipes Technologies et Produits numériques afin de prioriser les améliorations, garantir la fiabilité des plateformes et offrir une expérience utilisateur exceptionnelle. 

 Représenter les exigences des parties prenantes d’affaires tout au long des activités de planification, de développement, d’essais et de déploiement. 

 Technologies marketing et opérations: 
 Superviser la sélection, l’implantation, l’intégration et l’optimisation des solutions de technologies marketing, notamment les plateformes de gestion de la relation client (CRM), les outils d’automatisation marketing, les systèmes de gestion de contenu et les plateformes analytiques. 

 Mettre en place des processus opérationnels et des mécanismes de gouvernance afin d’assurer un déploiement efficace du contenu marketing sur les canaux numériques de l’organisation. 

 Favoriser l’excellence opérationnelle grâce à des initiatives d’amélioration des processus et à l’identification d’occasions d’automatisation. 

 Analyse et optimisation de la performance: 
 Évaluer les indicateurs de performance, les données sur la clientèle et les analyses numériques afin de mesurer l’efficacité des initiatives et de cibler les occasions d’amélioration. 

 Transformer les données en recommandations concrètes permettant d’améliorer l’expérience client, l’efficacité opérationnelle et les résultats d’affaires. 

 Effectuer une veille des tendances du secteur, des technologies émergentes et des meilleures pratiques numériques afin de maintenir un avantage concurrentiel.

 Influencer les décisions à l’échelle de l’organisation relativement aux capacités numériques, aux investissements technologiques et aux priorités opérationnelles. 

 Exigences de base: 
 Baccalauréat en marketing, en administration des affaires, en technologies de l’information ou dans un domaine connexe.

 Capacité à analyser les données et les tendances du marché afin d’éclairer les décisions stratégiques. 

 Expérience dans l’élaboration et l’exécution de stratégies liées aux plateformes numériques, aux technologies marketing ou à la transformation numérique. 

 Expérience dans la gestion de sites Web, d’applications mobiles, de plateformes numériques ou de solutions technologiques marketing d’envergure organisationnelle. 

 Expérience avec les plateformes CRM, les outils d’automatisation marketing, les systèmes de gestion de contenu et les solutions d’analytique numérique. 

 Expérience en gestion budgétaire et en optimisation du rendement du capital investi (RCI). 

 Excellentes aptitudes en leadership, en communication et en collaboration. 

 Compétences et expérience privilégiées: 
 Maîtrise en marketing, en administration des affaires, en technologies de l’information ou dans un domaine connexe. 

 Expérience dans les secteurs des soins de santé, du commerce de détail, de la distribution ou dans d’autres industries fortement réglementées.

 Directeur, Planification de la chaîne d’approvisionnement et transport 
 Aperçu du poste 
 Le directeur ou la directrice, Planification de la chaîne d’approvisionnement et transport, est responsable de diriger la stratégie technologique, la prestation de services et l’habilitation opérationnelle des plateformes et des capacités soutenant l’écosystème de planification de la chaîne d’approvisionnement et de transport de bout en bout de McKesson Canada.
 Ce rôle collabore étroitement avec les équipes de la chaîne d’approvisionnement, de la distribution pharmaceutique et des opérations, des approvisionnements, des opérations des centres de distribution, du transport, de l’analytique ainsi qu’avec des partenaires technologiques externes afin de garantir que les solutions de planification et de transport sont stables, sécurisées, évolutives et alignées sur les priorités de l’entreprise.
 Le poste fournit un leadership dans les domaines de la prévision de la demande, de la planification de l’approvisionnement, du réapprovisionnement, de l’optimisation des stocks, de l’exécution du transport, de la visibilité, de l’intégration des transporteurs et des flottes, de la qualité des données, de l’analytique et de l’intégration entre les systèmes.
 Le directeur ou la directrice est responsable d’assurer la fiabilité des services, de faire évoluer le modèle opérationnel, de réduire les frictions opérationnelles, d’améliorer la réalisation de la valeur d’affaires et de soutenir la modernisation technologique tout en gérant les risques, la conformité, la performance des fournisseurs et la discipline financière.

 Principales responsabilités 
 Leadership stratégique 
 Élaborer et exécuter la stratégie technologique et de services pour les solutions de planification de la chaîne d’approvisionnement et de transport, en assurant l’alignement avec les objectifs d’affaires de McKesson Canada, les priorités de croissance, les attentes en matière de niveaux de service et les besoins de résilience opérationnelle.
 Collaborer avec les dirigeants des secteurs d’affaires et de la technologie afin de définir des feuilles de route pluriannuelles pour la planification, le réapprovisionnement, la visibilité du transport, l’optimisation, l’automatisation, l’exploitation des données et la modernisation des plateformes de base.
 Fournir un leadership éclairé sur les tendances technologiques de la chaîne d’approvisionnement, y compris la planification avancée, l’optimisation, la prévision alimentée par l’IA et l’apprentissage automatique, l’évolution des plateformes SaaS, l’intégration fondée sur les API, l’analytique du transport et les capacités de visibilité numérique.
 Traduire les priorités d’affaires en plans technologiques exploitables, recommandations d’investissement, séquencement de la livraison et résultats mesurables en matière de valeur.
 Prestation des services et modèle opérationnel 
 Assurer la responsabilité et la maturité du modèle opérationnel de prestation des services pour les technologies de planification de la chaîne d’approvisionnement et de transport, y compris la définition claire des responsabilités, la gestion des demandes, la priorisation, la gestion des incidents et des problèmes, la gouvernance des mises en production, le contrôle des changements et l’amélioration continue.
 Définir et gérer les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI), les ententes de niveau de service (SLA/SLO), les mesures de consommation, la transparence des coûts et les rapports destinés à la direction relativement aux services de planification et de transport.
 Assurer un soutien fiable aux processus d’affaires complexes à volume élevé, notamment la prévision, la planification de l’approvisionnement, le réapprovisionnement, l’optimisation des stocks, la gestion des stocks par les fournisseurs, l’acheminement du transport, la visibilité des expéditions, l’intégration des centres de distribution, la visibilité des commandes ainsi que les interfaces avec les transporteurs et les flottes.
 Collaborer avec les responsables de produits d’affaires, les dirigeants opérationnels, le PMO, les équipes d’architecture, de données, de cybersécurité, d’infrastructure et les fournisseurs afin de coordonner les dépendances interservices et de réduire les transferts.
 Gestion d’équipe 
 Diriger, encadrer et développer une équipe multidisciplinaire composée de gestionnaires, d’analystes, d’ingénieurs, de responsables de services et de ressources fournisseurs soutenant les capacités de planification et de transport.
 Établir des objectifs et des attentes clairs, offrir du coaching et de la rétroaction, et favoriser une culture de responsabilisation, de collaboration, d’orientation client, de rigueur opérationnelle et d’apprentissage continu.
 Élaborer des plans de ressources et de capacités visant à répondre aux besoins en matière de connaissances du domaine, d’expertise des systèmes, de compétences d’intégration, d’analyse d’affaires, de qualité des données, de gestion des fournisseurs et de couverture du soutien.
 Promouvoir une planification efficace de la relève, la documentation, la formation croisée et la réduction des points de défaillance uniques.
 Développement et mise en œuvre de solutions 
 Superviser la conception, la mise en œuvre, l’amélioration et la gestion du cycle de vie des solutions technologiques de planification et de transport, en veillant à ce qu’elles soient évolutives, résilientes, sécurisées, faciles à soutenir et adaptées aux besoins de l’entreprise.
 Guider les équipes de livraison dans les activités liées aux exigences, à l’architecture, à la conception de l’intégration, au mappage des données, aux essais, au déploiement, à l’hypercare et à la préparation à la production.
 Assurer une intégration efficace entre les principales plateformes et les flux de données, notamment les systèmes de planification, les outils de transport, MBA/AS400 le cas échéant, l’EDI, les API, les plateformes analytiques, les données de référence, les tableaux de bord ainsi que les capacités de visibilité destinées aux clients en aval.
 Favoriser l’excellence de la livraison de projets, la saine gestion financière et la réalisation de la valeur dans le cadre des initiatives d’amélioration, de modernisation et de soutien opérationnel.
 Gestion des fournisseurs et des partenaires 
 Gérer les relations avec les fournisseurs externes, les partenaires technologiques et les prestataires de services soutenant les capacités de planification de la chaîne d’approvisionnement, de transport, d’analytique, d’intégration et de services gérés.
 Évaluer la performance des fournisseurs en fonction de leurs engagements, des SLA, des livrables, des modalités commerciales et des résultats d’affaires attendus.
 Soutenir la gestion du cycle de vie des contrats, les évaluations de renouvellement, les feuilles de route des fournisseurs, l’escalade des problèmes et les occasions de partenariats stratégiques.
 Veiller à ce que les fournisseurs assurent un transfert de connaissances efficace, une documentation adéquate, la maintenabilité des solutions et des pratiques opérationnelles durables.
 Gestion des risques et conformité 
 Veiller à ce que les solutions soient conformes aux politiques de McKesson, aux exigences de cybersécurité, aux normes de protection des renseignements personnels, aux attentes réglementaires, aux exigences d’audit et aux contrôles des risques technologiques.
 Maintenir les plans de résilience, de reprise après sinistre, de gestion des accès et de continuité des activités pour les services technologiques de planification et de transport.
 Identifier et atténuer de façon proactive les risques liés à la qualité des données, à la stabilité des plateformes, aux défaillances d’intégration, à la dépendance envers les fournisseurs, à la dette technique, à la préparation opérationnelle, à la sécurité et aux lacunes des processus.
 Mettre en place une gouvernance des changements en production, des interventions en cas d’incident, de l’analyse des causes profondes et des mesures correctives et préventives.
 Excellence opérationnelle et création de valeur 
 Favoriser l’excellence opérationnelle grâce à la normalisation des processus, à l’automatisation, à l’optimisation des coûts, à la simplification des plateformes, à la documentation et à l’amélioration continue des services.
 Collaborer avec les parties prenantes de l’entreprise afin d’améliorer les capacités de précision des prévisions, l’efficacité de la planification, le soutien à la prise de décisions relatives aux stocks, la visibilité du transport, les perspectives sur la performance des livraisons et la réactivité de la chaîne d’approvisionnement de bout en bout.
 Soutenir les discussions sur la priorisation en fournissant une information transparente sur les impacts d’affaires, la capacité, les risques, les coûts et les dépendances.
 Générer une valeur mesurable grâce à une meilleure fiabilité des services, à la réduction des efforts manuels, à une résolution plus rapide des problèmes, à une meilleure qualité des données, à une diminution des risques de conformité et à un meilleur alignement avec les besoins de l’entreprise.
 Indicateurs de succès 
 Réussite des livraisons mesurée selon les délais, la portée, le budget, la qualité, la préparation à la production et l’adoption par les utilisateurs.
 Réduction du volume d’incidents, de leur récurrence et du délai moyen de résolution; amélioration du respect des SLA/SLO pour les services critiques de planification et de transport.
 Amélioration de la transparence concernant la consommation des services, les facteurs de coûts, la performance des fournisseurs et les contraintes de capacité.
 Renforcement de la confiance des utilisateurs envers les plateformes de planification et de transport grâce à des opérations stables, à une meilleure qualité des données et à des intégrations fiables.
 Respect constant des exigences en matière de sécurité, de conformité, d’accès, de résilience et d’audit.
 Démonstration d’une valeur d’affaires grâce à des gains d’efficacité, à la réduction du travail manuel, à une meilleure aide à la décision, à une visibilité accrue et au soutien des résultats liés aux revenus, aux marges, au service et à l’expérience client.

 Qualifications minimales (connaissances, compétences et aptitudes) 
 Baccalauréat en technologies de l’information, en informatique, en chaîne d’approvisionnement, en génie, en administration des affaires ou expérience pratique équivalente; diplôme d’études supérieures ou certifications pertinentes considérés comme un atout.
 Minimum de 10 à 12 années d’expérience progressive en leadership technologique, incluant une expérience significative en gestion d’applications d’entreprise, prestation de services, transformation ou livraison de solutions dans les domaines de la chaîne d’approvisionnement, de la logistique, du transport, de la distribution ou des secteurs connexes.
 Expérience des technologies de planification de la chaîne d’approvisionnement et/ou de transport, notamment la prévision de la demande, la planification de l’approvisionnement, le réapprovisionnement, l’optimisation des stocks, les systèmes TMS/exécution du transport, l’intégration des itinéraires, des flottes et des transporteurs, la visibilité des expéditions, les intégrations EDI/API, les plateformes de données et l’analytique.
 Solide compréhension de la gestion des services TI, des modèles opérationnels de produits et de plateformes, des pratiques de livraison de projets, du cycle de développement logiciel (SDLC), des méthodologies Agile et Waterfall, du soutien à la production, de la gestion des incidents et des problèmes ainsi que de la gouvernance des mises en production.
 Capacité démontrée à collaborer avec des intervenants d’affaires de niveau supérieur, à traduire les besoins de l’entreprise en feuilles de route technologiques et à exercer une influence dans un environnement matriciel sans dépendre uniquement de l’autorité hiérarchique directe.
 Solides compétences en gestion des fournisseurs, supervision contractuelle, gestion financière et établissement des priorités.
 Expérience démontrée en leadership, incluant la création d’équipes engagées, le développement des talents, l’établissement d’orientations et l’amélioration de la responsabilisation.
 Excellentes compétences analytiques, en communication, en présentation à la direction, en résolution de problèmes et en prise de décision; le bilinguisme français-anglais est préféré pour interagir avec les parties prenantes canadiennes.
 Personne organisée, méthodique et attentive aux détails, capable de gérer plusieurs priorités, de travailler sous pression et de diriger efficacement en situation d’incident, d’ambiguïté et de changement.
 Orienté(e) vers le client et les résultats, avec un engagement envers une prestation de services de haute qualité et la création d’une valeur d’affaires mesurable.

 Conditions de travail 
 Présence au bureau requise. Nous appliquons un modèle Flex & Connect avec une présence au bureau de deux jours par semaine.

 Director, Supply Chain Planning & Transportation  
 Position Overview  
 The Director, Supply Chain Planning & Transportation is responsible for leading the technology strategy, service delivery, and operational enablement for platforms and capabilities supporting McKesson Canada’s end-to-end supply chain planning and transportation ecosystem. This role partners closely with Supply Chain, Pharmaceutical Distribution & Operations, Procurement, DC Operations, Transportation, Analytics, and external technology partners to ensure planning and transportation solutions are stable, secure, scalable, and aligned to business priorities. 
 The role provides leadership across demand forecasting, supply planning, replenishment, inventory optimization, transportation execution, visibility, carrier/fleet integration, data quality, analytics, and cross-system integration. The Director is accountable for delivering reliable services, maturing the operating model, reducing operational friction, improving business value realization, and enabling technology modernization while managing risk, compliance, vendor performance, and financial discipline. 

 Key Responsibilities  
 Strategic Leadership  
 Develop and execute the technology and service strategy for Supply Chain Planning and Transportation solutions, ensuring alignment with McKesson Canada business objectives, growth priorities, service-level expectations, and operational resilience needs. 
 Partner with senior business and technology leadership to define multi-year roadmaps for planning, replenishment, transportation visibility, optimization, automation, data enablement, and modernization of core platforms. 
 Provide thought leadership on supply chain technology trends, including advanced planning, optimization, AI/ML-enabled forecasting, SaaS platform evolution, API-based integration, transportation analytics, and digital visibility capabilities. 
 Translate business priorities into actionable technology plans, investment recommendations, delivery sequencing, and measurable value outcomes. 
 Service Delivery & Operating Model  
 Own and mature the Service Delivery Operating Model for Supply Chain Planning and Transportation technology services, including clear accountability, demand intake, prioritization, incident/problem management, release governance, change control, and continuous improvement. 
 Define and manage service KPIs, SLAs/SLOs, consumption metrics, cost transparency, and executive reporting for planning and transportation services. 
 Ensure reliable support for complex, high-volume business processes including forecasting, supply planning, replenishment, inventory optimization, vendor-managed inventory enablement, transportation routing, shipment visibility, DC integration, order visibility, and carrier/fleet interfaces. 
 Partner with business product owners, operations leaders, PMO, architecture, data, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and vendor teams to coordinate cross-service dependencies and reduce handoffs. 
 Team Management  
 Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary team of managers, analysts, engineers, service leads, and vendor resources supporting planning and transportation capabilities. 
 Set clear goals and expectations, provide coaching and feedback, and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, operational discipline, and continuous learning. 
 Build resource and capability plans that address domain knowledge, system expertise, integration skills, business analysis, data quality, vendor management, and support coverage needs. 
 Promote effective succession planning, documentation, cross-training, and reduction of single points of failure. 
 Solution Development & Implementation  
 Oversee design, implementation, enhancement, and lifecycle management of planning and transportation technology solutions, ensuring they are scalable, resilient, secure, supportable, and fit for business purpose. 
 Guide delivery teams through requirements, architecture, integration design, data mapping, testing, deployment, hypercare, and production readiness activities. 
 Ensure effective integration across key platforms and data flows, including planning systems, transportation tools, MBA/AS400 where applicable, EDI, APIs, analytics platforms, master data, dashboards, and downstream customer-facing visibility capabilities. 
 Drive project delivery excellence, financial stewardship, and value realization across enhancement, modernization, and operational support initiatives. 
 Vendor & Partner Management  
 Manage relationships with external vendors, technology partners, and service providers supporting supply chain planning, transportation, analytics, integration, and managed services capabilities. 
 Evaluate vendor performance against commitments, SLAs, deliverables, commercial terms, and expected business outcomes. 
 Support contract lifecycle management, renewal assessments, vendor roadmaps, issue escalation, and strategic partnership opportunities. 
 Ensure vendors provide effective knowledge transfer, documentation, supportability, and sustainable operating practices. 
 Risk Management & Compliance  
 Ensure solutions comply with McKesson policies, cybersecurity requirements, privacy standards, regulatory expectations, audit requirements, and technology risk controls. 
 Maintain resiliency, disaster recovery, access management, and business continuity plans for planning and transportation technology services. 
 Proactively identify and mitigate risks related to data quality, platform stability, integration failures, vendor dependency, technical debt, operational readiness, security, and process gaps. 
 Establish governance around production changes, incident response, root-cause analysis, and corrective/preventive actions. 
 Operational Excellence & Value Delivery  
 Drive operational excellence through process standardization, automation, cost optimization, platform simplification, documentation, and continuous service improvement. 
 Partner with business stakeholders to improve forecast accuracy enablement, planning efficiency, inventory decision support, transportation visibility, delivery performance insight, and end-to-end supply chain responsiveness. 
 Support prioritization discussions by providing transparent business impact, capacity, risk, cost, and dependency information. 
 Deliver measurable value through improved service reliability, reduced manual effort, faster issue resolution, better data quality, reduced compliance risk, and stronger business alignment. 
 Success Metrics  
 Delivery success measured by time, scope, budget, quality, production readiness, and business adoption. 
 Reduction in incident volume, recurrence, and mean time to resolution; improved SLA/SLO adherence for critical planning and transportation services. 
 Improved transparency of service consumption, cost drivers, vendor performance, and capacity constraints. 
 Improved business confidence in planning and transportation platforms through stable operations, data quality, and reliable integrations. 
 Security, compliance, access, resiliency, and audit expectations met consistently. 
 Demonstrated business value through efficiency gains, reduced manual work, improved decision support, enhanced visibility, and support for revenue, margin, service, and customer outcomes. 

 Minimum Job Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities):  
 Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree or relevant certifications are an asset. 
 Minimum 10–12 years of progressive technology leadership experience, including significant experience leading enterprise applications, service delivery, transformation, or solution delivery in supply chain, logistics, transportation, distribution, or related domains. 
 Experience with supply chain planning and/or transportation technology capabilities such as demand forecasting, supply planning, replenishment, inventory optimization, TMS/transportation execution, route/fleet/carrier integration, shipment visibility, EDI/API integrations, data platforms, and analytics. 
 Strong understanding of IT service management, product/platform operating models, project delivery practices, SDLC, Agile/Waterfall delivery, production support, incident/problem management, and release governance. 
 Demonstrated ability to partner with senior business stakeholders, translate business needs into technology roadmaps, and influence across matrixed teams without relying solely on direct authority. 
 Strong vendor management, contract oversight, financial management, and prioritization skills. 
 Proven leadership capability with experience building engaged teams, developing talent, setting direction, and improving accountability. 
 Strong analytical, communication, executive presentation, problem-solving, and decision-making skills; bilingual French/English preferred for Canadian stakeholder engagement. 
 Organized, methodical, and detail-oriented; able to manage multiple priorities, operate under pressure, and lead effectively through incidents, ambiguity, and change. 
 Customer-focused and outcome-oriented, with a commitment to high-quality service delivery and measurable business value.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Platform
jobs.description:
About Miovision: 
 At Miovision, we’re unlocking transportation networks that move you. Our vision and mission is to enable smart, fast, safe communities that simply flow, as we drive the Intelligent Mobility Revolution. Backed by the world’s most advanced traffic AI, Miovision’s innovations in traffic signal planning and operations are making it possible for cities to improve the transportation experience for drivers, cyclists and pedestrians.

Our values drive us. They’re at the core of everything we do. If they align with yours, proceed through the GREEN light!
 All in to win: We're driven by a winning mindset, approaching every challenge with intensity, clarity, and speed.

 One Miovision: We succeed as one team, uniting diverse talents, building on trust, and putting our shared mission before ego.

 Be better every day: We're committed to continuous growth, staying curious, building mastery, and embracing challenges as learning opportunities.

 Make it happen: We are proactive and results-driven, taking ownership, acting with urgency, and focusing on solutions that deliver real impact.

 Earn the customer: We are deeply customer-centric, focused on earning our customers' partnership every day by delivering exceptional experiences that drive their success.

 Position Summary: 
 At Miovision, we are engineering the future of smart transportation, and right now, we are laying down the asphalt for our most ambitious infrastructure project yet. We are building a governed, API-first technology platform that will act as the ultimate express lane for how we build software, enabling new experiences for customers, partners, and AI agents. We are looking for a Senior Director, Platform to serve as the master traffic controller for this massive transformation. Reporting to the SVP of Software Engineering & Technology, you will build the foundational highways that our entire product ecosystem travels on. You will steer our engineering organization away from gridlocked, application-centric development and into a high-speed, contract-driven future. If you are a hands-on leader ready to pave the way for AI-assisted innovation and ensure our platform capabilities always get the green light, it is time to take the wheel!

 Objectives and Responsibilities: 
 Platform Strategy & Architectural Foundation 
 Own the engineering strategy and translate our Platform North Star into clear architectural priorities for both human and AI-driven use cases.

 Spearhead the transition from application-centric integration toward a governed, contract-driven, API-first platform.

 Partner with Architecture to establish a durable technical foundation that protects long-term integrity while pragmatically supporting near-term delivery.

 Drive an engineering culture where teams naturally build on the platform because it is the absolute fastest and most effective path to delivering value.

 Organizational Leadership & Scaling 
 Lead, coach, and aggressively grow the Platform Engineering organization by recruiting top-tier talent with deep expertise in APIs, distributed systems, and AI.

 Build a highly resilient team culture grounded in ownership, curiosity, technical excellence, and high-velocity delivery.

 Lead the shift toward platform-first ways of working, building alignment, adoption, and accountability across the broader Engineering department.

 Create an environment where senior engineers are highly empowered to make decisions while remaining perfectly aligned with a shared architectural direction.

 Platform as a Product (First-Party, Third-Party & Ecosystem Enablement) 
 Partner with Product Leadership to operate the Platform exactly like a customer-facing product, treating internal developers, external partners, and AI agents as your core customers.

 Establish API contracts as first-class products that natively support authentication, observability, usage metering, and scalable commercial models from day one.

 Build a governed, unified entry point for Miovision's strategic capabilities, utilizing adoption data and developer feedback to continuously improve the ecosystem.

 Identify and build reusable, standardized capabilities—partnering with Data Science to integrate models and data products—eliminating isolated alternatives across the company.

 Technical Leadership & Hands-On Builder 
 Remain deeply engaged in the technology—reviewing architecture, exploring code, and prototyping solutions alongside your engineers to blast through ambiguity.

 Build the technical foundations for AI-assisted development, personally utilizing modern agentic tools and establishing AI-native practices across your team.

 Partner with Developer Operations to build automation and tooling that makes standardized, scalable architecture the absolute easiest path for our engineers.

 Bring razor-sharp technical judgment to complex distributed systems, helping teams practically evolve existing architecture without requiring massive, disruptive rewrites.

 Operational Excellence, Reliability & Trust 
 Establish world-class reliability, observability, security, and operational readiness as the fundamental DNA of all Platform capabilities.

 Ensure human and agent identity, delegated authorization, auditability, and guardrails are natively built into the platform rather than siloed across individual teams.

 Define strict lifecycle, compatibility, and service health standards so consumers can depend on Platform services with absolute confidence.

 Ensure the Platform seamlessly scales alongside Miovision’s rapidly growing products, customer base, and engineering organization without multiplying operational complexity.

 The Ideal Profile: 
 The Engineering Veteran: You bring 15+ years of software engineering experience with a heavy focus on platform engineering, distributed systems, and large-scale architecture.

 The Organization Builder: You have a proven track record of successfully leading, scaling, and coaching senior engineering teams in highly complex, multi-product environments.

 The API Architect: You boast deep technical expertise in API design, microservices, contract governance, and full API lifecycle management.

 The Platform Product Thinker: You treat platforms exactly like a product. Experience monetizing a platform, scaling a marketplace, or building a third-party developer ecosystem is strongly preferred.

 The AI-Native Leader: You have hands-on experience executing platform strategies that fundamentally change how engineering teams use AI to build, verify, and deliver software (including exposure to MCP and machine-readable interfaces).

 The Hands-On Builder: You are a highly credible technical leader who is just as comfortable exploring code and prototyping a solution as you are driving an executive strategy meeting.

 The Cloud Heavyweight: You have deep, practical familiarity with cloud-native architectures (AWS), Kubernetes, modern CI/CD, and languages like Java, Python, or Node.js.

 The Transformation Driver: You have demonstrated experience successfully driving massive architectural or engineering operating-model shifts within an organization.

 The Operations Sentinel: You possess a profound understanding of reliability, telemetry, security, and operational excellence in massive, high-stakes production systems.

 The Strategic Diplomat: You wield excellent communication and influence skills, capable of partnering flawlessly with Product Management, Architecture, and C-suite stakeholders.

 The Pragmatic Visionary: You excel at systems thinking—perfectly balancing the need for long-term architectural integrity with the reality of pragmatic, incremental delivery.

 Your Rewards & Well-being: 
We invest in our team with benefits designed for modern life and true work-life balance.
 Comprehensive Coverage: Your well-being is covered from day one with comprehensive health benefits, 24/7 virtual healthcare access, and dedicated wellness programs.

 Financial Future: Build for tomorrow with our RRSP/401K Matching Plan and share in the company's success through our Variable Incentive Plan.

 Time to Recharge: Truly unplug with our unique Mio-Days and flexible vacation policy.

 Work & Life Support: We support you with flexible work options, an internet subsidy, a remote work allowance, and enhanced leave for new parents.

 Sound like your next adventure? Apply now and let's start building together! 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Please indicate if you require accommodation on your application, and our team will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.
 Miovision may use artificial intelligence (AI) to assist in the hiring process for tasks such as helping to identify qualified candidates, taking meeting notes, creating summaries, and streamlining administrative work. These tools are one of several factors considered in the hiring process and do not replace human judgement. We do not use AI to make any final hiring or interview decisions. 
 PLEASE BE AWARE OF FRAUD: Applicants interested in applying for roles at Miovision should apply directly via the details provided on our careers page. We communicate directly with applicants and will not request banking information, payment, or fees during any point of the recruitment process. We do not conduct interviews via text message. If you suspect that a third party is impersonating Miovision or requesting payment for recruitment on behalf of Miovision, please alert us via recruitment@miovision.com.

 What You’ll Do 

 The Job:  Director, Data Architecture & Information Management

 As the  Director, Data Architecture & Information Management, you will serve as the organization’s designated authority and strategic leader for enterprise data architecture. Working across major business and technology initiatives, you will influence key decisions and lead the evolution of the enterprise data systems architecture, enterprise data model, and Master Data Management (MDM) capabilities.

 This leadership role is accountable for setting the strategic direction for data and establishing the standards, patterns, information models, and architecture review processes that govern how data is designed, integrated, and managed across the enterprise. Through this work, you will enable trusted, scalable, and reusable information assets that support business operations, analytics, digital initiatives, and AI capabilities.

 What You’ll Do 

 Provide architectural leadership and design oversight across major projects, programs, and technology initiatives that impact enterprise data.

 Partner with business and technology leaders to define future-state data capabilities and architecture roadmaps aligned with strategic priorities.

 Define and lead the organization’s Master Data Management (MDM) strategy, architecture, and roadmap, beginning with customer data and expanding across additional domains.

 Own and evolve the enterprise canonical data model and business information architecture to improve consistency, interoperability, reuse, and scalability.

 Establish and govern enterprise data architecture standards, design patterns, information models, reference architectures, and architecture review processes.

 Lead enterprise data modeling, metadata architecture, information lifecycle management, and related architectural practices.

 Evaluate emerging technologies, data platforms, and AI capabilities to strengthen the enterprise data architecture and create business value.

 Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of Data Architects, Data Modelers, and Data Engineers..

 What You’ll Bring 

 Required Qualifications 

 Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Management, or a related discipline.

 10+ years of progressive experience in enterprise data architecture, information architecture, data modeling, and information management.

 Proven success influencing enterprise-wide business and technology decisions through architectural leadership.

 Experience partnering with Enterprise, Solution, and Cloud Architects to establish end-to-end architecture strategies.

 Demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise data standards, architecture patterns, and governance processes.

 Strong expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling.

 Experience leading Master Data Management (MDM) initiatives and enterprise information management programs.

 Experience developing enterprise information models, integration standards, and reference architectures.

 Proven ability to collaborate with senior business and technology leaders to define future-state architecture roadmaps.

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Master’s degree in a related discipline.

 Experience within financial services or another highly regulated industry.

 Experience designing or supporting modern cloud-based data platforms, preferably Snowflake.

 Experience with modern data transformation and modeling practices using dbt or similar technologies.

 Experience enabling AI, advanced analytics, customer intelligence, and digital transformation initiatives.

 Experience building and leading architecture or information management teams.

 Committed to Equal Opportunity: 

 MFSG is committed to accommodating applicants up to the point of undue hardship during the recruitment, assessment and selection process. If you are selected for an interview, please notify MFSG if you require accommodation in respect of the materials or procedures used at any time during this process. If you require accommodation, MFSG will work with you to determine how to meet your needs.
  

 About MFSG – Our Commitment to Responsible Innovation

 At MFSG, we are committed to building innovative solutions grounded in ethical, transparent, and responsible use of data and technology. Aligned with the principles outlined in Canada’s Artificial Intelligence and Data Act (AIDA), we take a proactive approach to ensuring that any AI or data-driven systems we use are safe, fair, and accountable.

 This posting is for a current position within our organization, offering the opportunity to contribute to meaningful, responsible innovation that supports our employees, clients, and communities. 

 We prioritize strong data governance, clear communication around how systems work, and safeguards that reduce risks and protect individuals. Our focus is on developing tools and processes that promote equity, reliability, and trust, supported by ongoing monitoring and continuous improvement.

 Joining MFSG means contributing to a future-focused organization that values both innovation and integrity, where your work helps shape solutions that responsibly support our employees, clients, and communities.

jobs.title: Director, Quantitative Data Products
jobs.description:
Director, Quantitative Data Products 

 Nasdaq's Alternative Data group specializes in creating unique and insightful data products from non-traditional data sources. Well-known examples of Alternative Data include sentiment measures, real-time tracking of vehicles via GPS transponders, satellite monitoring of industrial facilities, and consumer insights gleaned from anonymized credit card transactions. Our data products empower some of the world's most sophisticated investment funds to outperform. 

 As Director of Quantitative Data Products, you'll play a critical role in defining strategy and driving execution of a portfolio of innovative Alternative Data products. You'll thrive in this position if you're entrepreneurial, data-driven, and strategic, with a deep understanding of investments and a passion for creating products that generate real business impact in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. The ideal candidate has trade floor and/or investments experience, with a strong understanding of buy-side and sell-side trading workflows. 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Conduct market research and engage directly with clients to identify new product opportunities and validate concepts.

 Own the full product lifecycle from ideation and validation through launch, scale, and ongoing optimization.

 Develop and prioritize product roadmaps that align with business objectives and drive measurable revenue growth.

 Partner with cross-functional teams including data science, data engineering, partnerships, client success, sales, and marketing to design and deliver innovative data products.

 Drive go-to-market strategy, including pricing, positioning, and sales enablement to maximize product adoption and success.

 Required Qualifications 
 10+ years of experience in product management, product development, and/or data analysis within the investment industry.

 Deep understanding of capital markets, data product fundamentals, and data feeds/products.

 Proven ability to conceptualize and drive new initiatives from 0-to-1 in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment.

 Excellent communicator with strong stakeholder management skills and a revenue-focused, owner mindset.

 Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, computer science, engineering, or related discipline.

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Strong understanding of the alternative data landscape, including key companies and products/services, as well as their competitive positioning.

 RBC has embarked on a transformational journey leveraging Generative AI and AI as a catalyst to drive significant productivity gains and revenue growth across the enterprise. You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives, orchestrating cross-functional collaboration across business lines, technology, risk, finance, and compliance. Reporting to executive leadership, you will be accountable for delivering measurable business impact while navigating complex organizational dynamics and driving cultural change across the bank.

 Your responsibilities will include: 
 Define and drive enterprise AI strategy: Partner with senior executives and business leaders to shape, structure, and prioritize AI programs that deliver measurable bottom-line impact and align with RBC's strategic objectives

 Provide executive counsel and thought leadership: Lead storytelling in executive forums through compelling presentations, business cases, and strategic communications that drive informed decision-making and maintain stakeholder confidence

 Optimize enterprise processes for AI delivery: Partner with senior leaders to streamline governance, risk, compliance, and procurement frameworks, enabling faster, more efficient deployment of AI solutions

 Manage risk and resolve strategic blockers: Proactively identify program risks, dependencies, and organizational impediments; escalate strategically to executive leadership to drive resolution and maintain momentum

 Develop and mentor program leadership: Build and guide a team of program managers, fostering a high-performance culture focused on delivery excellence and continuous improvement

 You're our ideal candidate if you: 
 Must-have:
 8+ years of progressive experience in strategy, digital transformation, management consulting, or financial services leadership roles

 Proven track record leading large-scale, enterprise-wide transformation programs with demonstrated business impact

 Deep expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and emerging digital technologies, with the ability to translate technical concepts for executive audiences

 Advanced degree (MBA, Master's in relevant field)

 Lead AI transformation at one of Canada's largest and most respected financial institutions, with direct visibility to Group Head and Operating Committee level leadership at RBC

jobs.description:
Job Description 

 What is the opportunity? 
 RBC's AI Group is building the future of AI-powered banking, and our AI Solutions Engineering team is responsible for translating cutting-edge AI research into production-ready, enterprise-grade solutions that serve millions of clients. Reporting to the VP, Solutions Engineering & Delivery, the Senior Director, AI Solutions Engineering will lead a team of software engineers and ML engineers responsible for building, deploying, and scaling AI solutions across RBC's business lines.
 This is a high-impact technical leadership role at the forefront of RBC's $1 billion AI ambition, where you'll combine deep software engineering expertise with AI solution delivery to build robust, scalable systems that power credit decisions, fraud detection, personalized client experiences, and innovative digital banking products. You'll bridge the gap between AI research, platform engineering, and business value delivery.
 You'll build and lead a high-performing engineering team that takes AI algorithms from Applied AI and Research teams and transforms them into mission-critical solutions integrated with RBC's enterprise platforms including Lumina, core banking systems, and digital channels. Your work will directly enable RBC to deploy AI at scale while meeting the rigorous performance, reliability, security, and regulatory requirements of a leading global financial institution.

 What will you do? 
 AI Solutions Engineering Leadership: 
 Lead the engineering, development & delivery of enterprise-grade AI solutions across multiple business domains, in support of RBC’s AI ambition.
 Ensure the successful deployment of AI solutions on RBC platforms. Provide production support and monitoring for AI models in partnership with T&O and business groups.
 As a member of RBC Borealis AI, partner with VP, Applied AI teams to translate research algorithms and ML models into production-ready software solutions that meet business requirements.
 Drive the technical roadmap for AI solutions engineering including architecture patterns, integration strategies, deployment automation, and operational excellence.
 Ensure all AI solutions meet RBC's standards for performance, reliability, scalability, security, and regulatory compliance. Collaborate with the VP, AI Architecture, Tools and Innovation team to ensure all AI solutions adhere to enterprise AI architecture standards, patterns, and governance frameworks.

 Work with AI Research and Applied AI teams to provide feedback on model development and influence research priorities based on productionization challenges.

 Team Leadership & Capability Building: 
 Build and lead a high-performing team of ML software engineers, AI engineers, UI/UX designers, data engineers, program managers and technical leads responsible for delivering AI solutions.

 What do you need to succeed? 
 Must Have: 
 12+ years of experience in software engineering, delivery,  platform engineering, or systems engineering roles with at least 5 years in leadership positions.
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field from a top-tier university.
 Proven track record building and deploying large-scale, mission-critical software systems in production environments at leading technology companies.
 Strong experience with enterprise software delivery, system integration, and working with complex legacy and modern technology stacks.
 Preferably experience in financial services or other regulated industries with understanding of compliance and governance requirements.

 Experience with ML productization, MLOps, model deployment, and production ML systems.
 Hands-on experience with AI/ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) and understanding of machine learning model architectures.
 Background in data engineering, real-time data pipelines, or integration with enterprise data platforms.

jobs.title: Director, AI Delivery & Portfolio Management – Global Payments Technology
jobs.description:
Job Description 

 What is the Opportunity? 
 RBC's Global Payments Technology organization is modernizing international payments infrastructure across real-time payments, cross-border transactions, debit cards, ACH, and emerging payment channels. We're now scaling AI capabilities to enhance fraud detection, optimize payment routing, improve transaction monitoring, and drive operational efficiency across our global payments ecosystem.
 We're seeking an exceptional delivery leader to orchestrate multiple large AI programs within Global Payments Technology while establishing AI-native delivery practices that respect the security, compliance, and reliability demands of mission-critical payments systems.
 As Director, AI Delivery & Portfolio Management – Global Payments Technology, you will lead a strategic portfolio of AI initiatives across research, engineering, platform, and business teams. You will drive alignment across complex programs, champion modern AI delivery methodologies, and ensure program management evolves to embrace AI's iterative nature while maintaining stringent operational and regulatory standards.
 Reporting to the Senior Director, Program Delivery, you will own end-to-end delivery accountability for this strategic AI portfolio while establishing AI SDLC standards that shape how RBC delivers AI solutions for payments at scale.

 What will you do? 
 Program & Portfolio Leadership 
 Lead delivery on multiple concurrent AI initiatives focused on payments innovation (fraud detection, payment routing optimization, transaction monitoring, operational efficiency) with high complexity, uncertainty, and strategic value
 Manage portfolio-level roadmaps, dependencies, and resource allocation across payments-focused AI programs
 Own end-to-end delivery accountability from planning through production deployment and value realization for each initiative, ensuring seamless integration with RBC's global payments infrastructure
 Develop and maintain program roadmaps, milestones, dependency plans, and execution strategies aligned with business objectives and approved timelines, budgets, and scope
 Coordinate activities across AI Research, AI Solutions Engineering, platform teams, payments operations, governance partners, and business stakeholders across international payments, debit cards, ACH, RTR, and payment channel teams

 Payments Domain Expertise & AI SDLC Development 
 Maintain strong understanding of Global Payments Technology domain: international payments flows, debit card processing, ACH, Real-Time Payments (RTR/FedNow), SWIFT, cross-border settlement, and emerging payment channels
 Champion the evolution and operationalization of AI-native software development lifecycle practices tailored to payments systems, where reliability, security, and regulatory compliance are non-negotiable
 Establish standards and processes that reflect the unique characteristics of AI development in payments (model development, experimentation, data pipelines, validation, monitoring, fraud pattern evolution)
 Influence engineering teams and stakeholders toward adoption of modern AI delivery practices including continuous training, model governance, MLOps, production monitoring, and explainability requirements critical to payments
 Balance traditional delivery discipline with the iterative, experimental nature of AI development; advise teams on risk-based approaches to AI model validation and deployment in payments contexts
 Drive knowledge sharing across programs on AI SDLC best practices, payments-specific lessons learned, and regulatory considerations

 Cross-Functional Team Leadership 
 Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement across diverse technical teams (data scientists, ML engineers, platform engineers, payments domain experts, infrastructure teams, and business partners)
 Build trusted relationships across business, engineering, platform, payments operations, compliance, and governance functions; serve as the primary delivery point of contact for senior stakeholders
 Lead large cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders across business and technology organizations within Global Payments Technology
 Coach delivery leads and team members on program management best practices tailored to AI initiatives in payments; share payments domain knowledge across delivery teams
 Work effectively with Global Payments business partners, payment network providers (networks, central banks, regulators), and third-party payment solution providers

 Delivery Execution & Governance 
 Establish effective governance processes including status reviews, risk management, issue resolution, and executive reporting that account for payments-specific compliance and operational requirements
 Monitor initiative health through delivery metrics, OKRs, KPIs, and operational dashboards; maintain performance visibility and accountability
 Identify and proactively resolve delivery bottlenecks, technical dependencies, organizational challenges, and AI-specific risks (model performance, data quality, fairness, regulatory compliance, payment accuracy, fraud evolution)
 Anticipate and quantify tactical, operational, and strategic risks specific to payments (transaction volume spikes, regulatory changes, network disruptions); apply risk-based approaches to forecasting and mitigation
 Manage program-level communications including status reports, executive updates, steering committee materials, and regulatory/compliance reporting as required
 Ensure delivery teams maintain rigorous quality assurance and testing standards appropriate to mission-critical payments systems

 Technical Leadership & Stakeholder Management 
 Develop strong understanding of AI solution architecture for payments, data ecosystems, platform capabilities, and operational requirements supporting payments initiatives
 Partner with engineering leaders, architects, product teams, payments domain experts, data governance partners, and compliance teams to understand technical requirements, constraints, and delivery dependencies
 Translate technical AI concepts into clear business language and payments-specific business requirements into actionable delivery plans
 Balance business priorities, technical quality, delivery timelines, and payments-specific considerations (security, compliance, SLA requirements) when supporting implementation decisions
 Manage stakeholder expectations through transparent communication and proactive management of complex, high-pressure situations inherent in payments technology
 Ensure technical risks are identified, communicated, and mitigated throughout the delivery lifecycle, with particular attention to payments system stability and data security

 Resource, Risk & Financial Management 
 Manage initiative budgets, forecasts, resource plans, and vendor engagements across the payments AI portfolio
 Ensure effective utilization of resources while balancing delivery commitments and organizational priorities
 Track financial performance and value realization against approved business cases; drive ROI visibility and accountability
 Identify, communicate, and mitigate risks impacting timelines, scope, quality, or business outcomes, including payments-specific operational and regulatory risks
 Drive timely issue resolution and escalation management; facilitate decision-making to maintain delivery momentum while protecting payment system integrity

 What do you need to succeed? 
 Must have: 
 10+ years of experience managing large and complex transformation programs or technology initiatives
 Strong understanding of payments domain (international payments, debit cards, ACH, RTR, cross-border settlement, or related payment channels) OR proven ability to quickly master complex domain requirements
 Strong understanding of AI/ML software delivery lifecycle, Agile methodologies, modern engineering practices
 Expert knowledge of program and project plan development & management, scheduling methodology, and program metrics/analysis
 Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving capabilities with demonstrated ability to lead and influence large cross-functional teams across business and technology organizations
 Experience managing program-level budgets, delivery plans, risks, dependencies, and executive communications

 Nice to have: 
 Demonstrated experience leading technology delivery in payments, financial services, or similarly regulated/mission-critical environments
 Background as a software engineer, data engineer, ML engineer, payments engineer, or distinguished engineer who transitioned into delivery leadership
 Experience driving cultural transformation and organizational change in payments or technology organizations
 Proven people management skills and ability to retain top technical talent

 What's in it for you? 
 We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.
 A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses, flexible benefits, competitive compensation, and stock where applicable
 Leaders who support your development through coaching and mentoring opportunities
 Ability to make a difference and lasting impact on how RBC delivers AI solutions for global payments at enterprise scale
 Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team at the forefront of AI innovation in payments technology
 World-class training and development programs in AI, financial services, payments systems, and leadership
 Flexible work/life balance options
 Opportunities to do challenging, meaningful work that shapes the future of global payments infrastructure
